1. Detuning-robust Rydberg entangling gates from echoed pulses PASS
Score: 123.0 / 3.0
Authors: Zhubing Jia, Yichao Yu, Xiye Hu, Lintao Li, Jacob Zheng, Christopher Monroe, Jacob P. Covey
Published: 2026-08-26
Version: v2
TL;DR: The paper presents echoed-pulse Rydberg entangling gates that shift all leading-order detuning errors into single-qubit Z-rotations, enabling a maximally-entangling ZZ gate with greatly improved robustness to laser frequency and field fluctuations for fault-tolerant neutral atom quantum computing.
摘要翻译

基于里德伯（Rydberg）的两量子比特门在中性原子阵列中的保真度主要受限于激光强度不均匀性，以及由频率校准误差、背景场漂移、中间态光移和多普勒频移引起的失谐（detuning）误差。量子最优控制可以抑制前者，但没有任何脉冲能使受控-Z（controlled-Z）门对失谐实现一阶不敏感。我们证明，这一障碍可以通过设计里德伯门脉冲来绕开：将所有领头阶失谐误差全部归入单量子比特的Z旋转（Z-rotations），并利用回波序列将其消除。由此得到的最大纠缠ZZ门对两个原子上的任意失谐均无领头阶响应，在远宽于时间最优门的单原子失谐范围内，其不保真度（infidelity）仍低于$10^{-3}$。我们进一步表明，残余误差的很大一部分由计算子空间之外的布居（population）主导，而这部分布居可以转化为可宣告的擦除（heralded erasures）。我们的结果显著降低了对激光频率稳定性、强度均匀性、场校准和原子温度的要求，为基于中性原子的实用容错量子计算创造了条件。

Abstract

Rydberg-based two-qubit gate fidelities in neutral atom arrays are limited chiefly by laser intensity inhomogeneity and by detuning errors from frequency miscalibration, background-field drift, intermediate state light shift and Doppler shifts. Quantum optimal control can suppress the former, but no pulse can render a controlled-Z gate first-order insensitive to detuning. Here we show that this obstruction can be circumvented by designing Rydberg gate pulses with every leading-order detuning error relegated to single-qubit Z-rotations, which an echoed sequence removes. The resulting maximally-entangling ZZ gate has no leading-order response to arbitrary detunings on either atom, maintaining an infidelity below $10^{-3}$ within a much wider range of single-atom detunings than the time-optimal gates. We further show that a large fraction of residual error is dominated by population outside the computational subspace, which can be converted into heralded erasures. Our results significantly reduce the requirements on laser frequency stability and intensity homogeneity, field calibration and atomic temperature toward practical fault-tolerant quantum computing with neutral atoms.

2. Nonthermal Dynamics of a One-dimensional Rydberg-atom Chain with Constraint Four-body Interactions PASS
Score: 122.0 / 3.0
Authors: Tianyi Yan, Weibin Li
Published: 2026-08-20
Version: v2
TL;DR: The paper analytically obtains the ground-state energy of a one-dimensional Rydberg-atom chain with constrained four-body interactions and demonstrates that the model hosts quantum many-body scars leading to nonthermal, non-ergodic dynamics with revivals, realizable via Rydberg blockade and antiblockade.
摘要翻译

我们研究了一条由受约束的四体相互作用驱动的里德伯原子线性链的动力学。该相互作用使得两个相邻原子仅当它们各自外侧的最近邻原子均处于|0⟩态时，才会同时从电子基态|0⟩激发到里德伯态|1⟩。通过采用多体基态的ansatz（拟设），低能哈密顿量可化为三对角形式。多体基态能量与链长L呈线性标度，我们在热力学极限下解析求得该能量，与精确对角化所得结果一致。我们的模型支持能量近似等间距的量子多体疤痕本征态。这些疤痕态与基态|0⟩=|0⋯0⟩有很强的重叠。我们证明，该重叠分布会因依赖态的四体相互作用而发生倾斜，从而导致非遍历动力学，其表现为初始态的恢复。该四体约束模型可通过具有交替键长的Peierls阵列中的里德伯原子实现，其中位于较短键和较长键上的原子分别经历里德伯阻塞和反阻塞。我们的研究将里德伯阻塞与反阻塞相结合，为探索具有四体相互作用的受约束非遍历动力学提供了一条途径。

Abstract

We investigate dynamics of a linear chain of Rydberg atoms driven by a constrained four-body interaction, where two neighboring atoms are excited simultaneously from the electronic ground state $|0\rangle$ to Rydberg state $|1\rangle$ only when their closest neighbors are in $|0\rangle$ state. By employing an ansatz for the many-body ground state, the low-energy Hamiltonian is given by a tridiagonal form. The many-body ground state energy, which scales linearly with the chain length $L$, is obtained analytically in the thermodynamic limit and agrees with the one of the exact diagonalization. Our model supports quantum many-body scar eigenstates that are nearly equally spaced energetically. The scar states overlap strongly with the basis state $|\mathbf{0}\rangle=|0\cdots 0\rangle$. We show that the overlap distribution is tilted by the state-dependent four-body interaction. This leads to non-ergodic dynamics, evidenced by the revival of the initial state. The four-body constrained model can be realized with Rydberg atoms in a Peierls array with alternating bond lengths, where atoms on the shorter and longer bonds experience Rydberg blockade and antiblockade, respectively. Our study provides a pathway to explore constrained non-ergodic dynamics with four-body interactions by combining the Rydberg blockade and antiblockade.

3. All-optical universal control of nuclear-spin qudits in trapped neutral atoms PASS

Published: 2026-05-10

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种针对中性原子中核自旋量子比特（qudit）的全光通用控制方案，基于173Yb的Rydberg阻塞机制实现高保真量子门，为基于qudit的量子信息处理提供了可行平台。
摘要翻译

具有多于两个能级的量子系统——即所谓的qudit——相比基于qubit的架构提供了更高的计算密度和更低的电路复杂度，但实现通用且可扩展的控制仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种在全光条件下对中等至强磁场中囚禁的中性原子实现通用qudit控制的方案，重点研究费米子同位素173Yb（I = 5/2）。3P1能级中强大的超精细相互作用使得仅用一束线偏振激光即可在1S0基态能级中的核自旋态之间实现快速且选择性的拉曼跃迁。对于qudit能级中每一对相邻跃迁，我们确定了一个魔幻偏振角，该角度能够实现相干、态选择性的控制，同时抑制非共振激发，工作频率超过100 kHz。结合相移操作，这为完整的单qudit空间提供了通用控制。我们进一步讨论了基于里德伯阻塞机制的兼容双qudit门，从而构成完整的通用门集，并分析了与该方案兼容的态选择性读出方案。我们的结果表明，173Yb是用于高保真度、全光、基于qudit的量子信息处理的一个有前景的平台。

Abstract

Quantum systems with more than two levels - so-called qudits - offer increased computational density and reduced circuit complexity compared to qubit-based architectures, but achieving universal and scalable control remains challenging. We propose an all-optical scheme for universal qudit control in trapped neutral atoms in moderate to high magnetic fields, focusing on the fermionic isotope 173Yb (I = 5/2). The strong hyperfine interaction in the 3P1 manifold enables fast and selective Raman transitions between nuclear-spin states in the 1S0 ground-state manifold using a single linearly polarized laser. For each neighboring transition in the qudit manifold, we identify a magic polarization angle that enables coherent, state-selective control while suppressing off-resonant excitations, with operation frequencies exceeding 100 kHz. Combined with phase-shift operations, this provides universal control of the full single-qudit space. We further discuss compatible two-qudit gates based on the Rydberg blockade mechanism, completing a universal gate set, and analyze state-selective readout schemes compatible with the proposed protocol. Our results identify 173Yb as a promising platform for high-fidelity, all-optical qudit-based quantum information processing.

4. Physics-informed quantum algorithms for glueball-like excitations in a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ lattice gauge theory PASS
Score: 89.0 / 3.0
Authors: Dan-Bo Zhang
Published: 2026-08-26
Version: v2
TL;DR: 针对(2+1)维Z2格点规范理论，论文提出了一套物理启发的量子算法工具箱，通过有效的真空制备、激发构造、特征压缩和动力学检测来模拟胶球样激发及其实时产生，并可推广至非阿贝尔格点规范理论。
摘要翻译

利用量子计算研究胶球谱学(glueball spectroscopy)和胶球的实时产生(real-time production)需要三个不同要素：关联的规范真空、对纯规范激发的受控构造，以及动力学探测器。我们在一(2+1)维Z2格点规范理论中为这些任务开发了一套物理启发的量子算法工具箱。我们使用“类胶球(glueball-like)”一词来指称该阿贝尔模型禁闭相中的局域化闭合通量激发，但不把这些激发等同于量子色动力学(QCD)中的非阿贝尔胶球。环气(loop-gas)电路和哈密顿量变分拟设(Hamiltonian variational ansatz)用于制备规范真空；基于Wilson环的量子子空间展开(Wilson-loop quantum subspace expansion)构造并刻画低激发态；本征向量延拓(eigenvector continuation)则引入依赖参数的缀饰，而无需对显式环基进行急剧扩充。一种Bethe-Salpeter型跃迁振幅定量描述了最轻态的空间展宽。对于动力学过程，一个真空缀饰的可收缩环计数器可测量局域类胶球结构的额外产生。尽管该工具箱是在阿贝尔模型中演示的，但它将制备、构造、压缩、刻画和动力学探测区分开来，其形式可自然推广至非阿贝尔格点规范理论。

Abstract

Glueball spectroscopy and real-time production with quantum computing require three distinct ingredients: a correlated gauge vacuum, a controlled construction of pure-gauge excitations, and a dynamical detector. We develop a physics-informed quantum-algorithm toolbox for these tasks in a $(2+1)$-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ lattice gauge theory. We use the term \emph{glueball-like} for localized closed-flux excitations on the confining side of this Abelian model, without identifying them with the non-Abelian glueballs of QCD. A loop-gas circuit and Hamiltonian variational ansatz prepare the gauge vacuum, Wilson-loop quantum subspace expansion constructs and characterizes low-lying excitations, and eigenvector continuation imports parameter-dependent dressing without a rapidly enlarged explicit loop basis. A Bethe--Salpeter-type transition amplitude quantifies the spatial broadening of the lightest state. For dynamics, a vacuum-dressed contractible-loop counter measures excess production of localized glueball-like structures. Although demonstrated in an Abelian model, the toolbox separates preparation, construction, compression, characterization, and dynamical detection in a form that is naturally extensible to non-Abelian lattice gauge theories.

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用反绝热驱动（counterdiabatic driving）加速非平衡量子湖态的模拟制备，并在 Z2 Rydberg 量子自旋液体模型中证明了将近一个数量级的加速效果。
摘要翻译

动力学制备奇异多体量子态一直是类比量子模拟的持久目标，但往往受限于实验相干时间。近期研究表明，在某些设置中，快速非绝热哈密顿量参数扫描可以产生有限尺寸的量子有序“湖泊”，且与基态相图中存在何种序无关。在此，我们证明通过外部驱动进一步远离平衡可以大幅加速这些量子湖泊的制备。具体而言，当湖泊可以被制备时，现有的反绝热驱动技术——最初设计用于靶向基态——反而自然地靶向湖泊态。我们分别通过一个示例性的单qutrit模型和一个\(\mathbb{Z}_2\) Rydberg量子自旋液体模型对此进行了演示。在后者中，我们构建了实验驱动序列，在固定激光功率下将制备速度加速近一个数量级。最后，我们使用Landau-Ginzburg模型为我们的方法如何加速态制备提供半经典图像。

Abstract

The dynamical preparation of exotic many-body quantum states is a persistent goal of analog quantum simulation, often limited by experimental coherence times. Recently, it was shown that fast, non-adiabatic Hamiltonian parameter sweeps can create finite-size ``lakes'' of quantum order in certain settings, independent of what is present in the ground state phase diagram. Here, we show that going further out of equilibrium via external driving can substantially accelerate the preparation of these quantum lakes. Concretely, when lakes can be prepared, existing counterdiabatic driving techniques -- originally designed to target the ground state -- instead naturally target the lakes state. We demonstrate this both for an illustrative single qutrit and a model of a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Rydberg quantum spin liquid. In the latter case, we construct experimental drive sequences that accelerate preparation by almost an order of magnitude at fixed laser power. We conclude by using a Landau-Ginzburg model to provide a semi-classical picture for how our method accelerates state preparation.

TL;DR: This paper establishes a holographic duality linking steady states of strongly symmetric repeated quantum channels to the boundary of one-higher-dimensional topological states, using isometric tensor networks to show that boundary strong-to-weak symmetry breaking originates from bulk anyon condensation.
摘要翻译

我们提出了一个全息框架，用于分析具有强对称性的重复量子信道的稳态。利用信道-态对偶，我们证明了d维量子信道的稳态可被全息映射到一个由顺序幺正线路生成的(d+1)维波函数的边界约化密度矩阵。从这个角度看，稳态中的强到弱自发对称性破缺(SWSSB)源于高一个维度中的拓扑序在其边界上的任意子凝聚。与SWSSB相关的条件互信息(CMI)则继承自体内(bulk)的拓扑纠缠熵。我们通过等距张量网络态(isoTNS)使该对偶显式化，即将信道的时间演化与高维isoTNS的转移矩阵等同起来。在isoTNS的基础上，我们进一步构造了连续可调的量子信道，其稳态呈现出不同的混合态相及相变。

Abstract

We introduce a holographic framework for analyzing the steady states of repeated quantum channels with strong symmetries. Using channel-state duality, we show that the steady state of a $d$-dimensional quantum channel is holographically mapped to the boundary reduced density matrix of a $(d+1)$-dimensional wavefunction generated by a sequential unitary circuit. From this perspective, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) in the steady state arises from the anyon condensation on the boundary of a topological order in one higher dimension. The conditional mutual information (CMI) associated with SWSSB is then inherited from the bulk topological entanglement entropy. We make this duality explicit using isometric tensor network states (isoTNS) by identifying the channel's time evolution with the transfer matrix of a higher-dimensional isoTNS. Built on isoTNS, we further construct continuously tunable quantum channels that exhibit distinct mixed-state phases and transitions in the steady states.

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了U(1)量子链模型中高斯定律扇区的符号问题图景，证明了基态所在的无符号问题扇区可映射到量子二聚体模型，并揭示了相关扇区的相结构。
摘要翻译

费米子符号问题对使用蒙特卡洛方法处理含动力学费米子物质场的格点规范理论构成了严峻挑战。最近为表示为自旋-$\frac{1}{2}$量子链（quantum links）并耦合单种味道交错费米子（staggered fermions）的规范场提出的meron簇算法，在低温下仅采样了指数多个高斯定律（Gauss law, GL）扇区中的两个，从而允许在多项式时间内模拟这两个GL扇区的零温行为。在本文中，我们解析地识别了在任意空间维度中可以在不遇到费米子符号问题的情况下进行模拟的GL扇区。利用大规模精确对角化和簇蒙特卡洛方法，我们探索了在零温下占主导的GL扇区中相的性质。基态存在于无符号问题的超选择扇区中，并映射到含可移动单体的量子二聚体模型（quantum dimer model）。通常的零电荷GL扇区存在费米子符号问题，并映射到含可移动单体的完全填充环模型（fully packed loop model）。我们概述了磁能在引起GL扇区之间跃迁中的作用。我们预期我们的结果适用于截断的Kogut-Susskind规范理论，而不仅限于量子链模型。

Abstract

The fermion sign problem poses a formidable challenge to the use of Monte Carlo methods for lattice gauge theories with dynamical fermionic matter fields. A meron cluster algorithm recently formulated for gauge fields represented as spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ quantum links coupled to a single flavour of staggered fermions samples only two of the exponentially many Gauss law (GL) sectors at low temperatures, allowing the simulation of those two GL sectors at zero temperature in polynomial time. In this article, we analytically identify GL sectors which can be simulated without encountering the fermion sign problem in arbitrary spatial dimensions. Using large-scale exact diagonalization and cluster Monte Carlo methods, we explore the nature of phases in the GL sectors dominating at zero temperature. The ground state lives in a superselection sector free of the sign problem, and maps to the quantum dimer model with mobile monomers. The usual zero-charge GL sector suffers from the fermion sign problem, and maps to the fully packed loop model with mobile monomers. The role of the magnetic energy in causing transitions between GL sectors is outlined. We expect our results to be valid for truncated Kogut-Susskind gauge theories, beyond quantum link models.

长程相互作用可以从根本上重塑低维量子物质的低能性质，同时改变连续对称性破缺与拓扑现象。然而，它们对分隔这些区域的量子临界行为的影响仍知之甚少。我们利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）计算，并辅以高阶级数展开（pCUT+MC），确定了具有单离子各向异性和交错反铁磁幂律相互作用的自旋为1的海森堡链的基态相图与临界性质。这类长程、无阻挫的相互作用绕过了霍恩贝格-默明-瓦格纳（Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner）定理的限制，从而稳定了连续对称性破缺（CSB）相，使其与Haldane相直接竞争。我们绘制了由此产生的相图，并分析了U(1)和SU(2)连续对称性破缺相中的纠缠熵标度行为，发现除线性色散戈德斯通（Goldstone）模式所预期的短程普适贡献外，还存在对数修正。我们进一步通过纠缠熵或交错磁化强度的有限尺寸标度，刻画了所有临界边界。特别地，大D相到U(1)-CSB相的相变表现出非常规的、随长程衰变指数连续变化的临界指数，并强烈依赖于所施加的边界条件，从而在足够长程的势下导致不同的有限尺寸标度。值得注意的是，Haldane相到U(1)-CSB相的相变同样展现出非常规的量子临界行为，其临界指数也连续变化但数值不同。我们的工作将该模型定位为近期原子平台的目标体系，这类平台具有可调长程耦合和天然单离子各向异性，为探索长程相互作用、连续对称性破缺与拓扑之间的相互影响提供了一个极简实验场。

Abstract

Long-range interactions can fundamentally reshape the low-energy properties of low-dimensional quantum matter, altering both continuous symmetry breaking and topological phenomena. However, their impact on the quantum criticality separating these regimes remains poorly understood. We determine the ground-state phase diagram and critical properties of the spin-one Heisenberg chain with single-ion anisotropy and staggered antiferromagnetic power-law interactions, using matrix-product state (MPS) calculations complemented by high-order series expansions (pCUT+MC). Such long-range, non-frustrated interactions circumvent the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner theorem, thereby stabilizing continuous symmetry breaking (CSB) phases in direct competition with the Haldane phase. We map out the resulting phase diagram and analyze the entanglement entropy scaling behavior in the U(1) and SU(2) CSB phases, finding logarithmic corrections beyond the short-range, universal contributions expected from linearly dispersed Goldstone modes. We further characterize all critical boundaries through finite-size scaling of either the entanglement entropy or the staggered magnetization. In particular, the large-D-to-U(1)-CSB transition exhibits unconventional, continuously varying critical exponents as a function of the long-range decay exponent with a strong dependence on the imposed boundary conditions leading to distinct finite-size scalings for sufficiently long-range potentials. Remarkably, the Haldane-to-U(1)-CSB transition likewise displays unconventional quantum criticality with distinct continuously varying critical exponents. Our work positions this model as a target for near-term atomic platforms with tunable long-range couplings and exhibiting natural single-ion anisotropy, offering a minimal playground for exploring the interplay between long-range interactions, continuous symmetry breaking, and topology.

摘要翻译

耗散相变受到林德布拉德算符对称性的强烈影响，然而目前关于弱对称性和强对称性对临界行为的定量影响尚缺乏清晰认识。我们研究了一个具有单光子和双光子损耗的压缩光子模型，在最简设置中实现了弱对称性和强对称性。这两种对称性展现出完全相同的高斯静态涨落，而序参量和渐近衰减率则表现出迥异的标度行为。我们的单圈Keldysh分析结合累积量展开数值计算揭示了相对于热力学标度参数截然不同的临界标度行为。这表明，尽管弱对称性和强对称性源于封闭系统中的同一对称群，它们却导致不同的动力学普适类。我们的结果为强对称性从根本上重塑耗散临界性提供了清晰的定量论证。

Abstract

Dissipative phase transitions are strongly shaped by the symmetries of the Liouvillian, yet a clear understanding of the quantitative impact of weak and strong symmetries on critical behavior is presently lacking. We study a squeezed-photon model with single- and two-photon losses, realizing weak and strong symmetries in the simplest possible setting. The two symmetries exhibit identical Gaussian static fluctuations, whereas the order parameter and the asymptotic decay rate display distinct scaling behaviors. Our one-loop Keldysh analysis, together with cumulant-expansion numerics, reveals sharply different critical scaling with respect to the thermodynamic scaling parameter. This shows that weak and strong symmetries lead to distinct dynamical universality classes despite originating from the same symmetry group in the closed system. Our results provide a clear quantitative demonstration that strong symmetries fundamentally reshape dissipative criticality.

摘要翻译

我们引入了波映图（wavemap）：一种噪声效应的空间描绘，为每个位点赋予每个噪声水平的到达延迟 l_γ(v) 和交叉熵损失 L_γ(v)。这些可观测量在光锥前沿（lightcone frontier）处是精确的，此时键维数（bond dimension）χ 较小，模拟最为可靠。对由门与噪声组成的泡利传递矩阵（Pauli transfer matrices）进行的本征值分析证实，所研究的噪声为纯振幅阻尼（amplitude damping）：空间传播模式完全由门决定，这使得波映图成为一种无模型（model-free）噪声诊断工具。我们应用多乘积公式（multi-product formula, MPF）从含噪样本中恢复无噪声的泡利权重场，并受利布-罗宾逊因果约束（Lieb-Robinson causal constraint）n_MPF ≤ n_nl 的限制。在前沿上拟合随时间自适应的系数 α(t)，相对于最佳含噪样本可恢复高达55%的信息损失，这利用了前沿处截断误差最小的特性。在具有异构硬件噪声的IBM重六角（heavy-hex）晶格上，该方法识别出一个信息匮乏（information-starved）区域，表明校准的合成噪声是下一步所需的实验。

Abstract

We introduce the wavemap: a spatial portrait of noise effects that assigns each site a per-noise-level arrival delay l_γ(v) and cross-entropy loss L_γ(v). These observables are exact at the lightcone frontier, where bond dimension χis small and the simulation is most faithful. Eigenvalue analysis of the composed gate-plus-noise Pauli transfer matrices confirms that the studied noise is pure amplitude damping: the spatial propagation pattern is entirely determined by the gate, making the wavemap a model-free noise diagnostic. We apply the multi-product formula (MPF) to recover the noiseless Pauli weight field from the noisy samples, subject to the Lieb-Robinson causal constraint nMPF <= nnl . Fitting time-adaptive coefficients α(t) over the frontier recovers up to 55% of the information loss relative to the best noisy sample, exploiting the fact that the frontier is where truncation error is smallest. On an IBM heavy-hex lattice with heterogeneous hardware noise the method identifies an information-starved regime, pointing to calibrated synthetic noise as the next required experiment.

摘要翻译

格点QCD（lattice QCD）等规范理论给量子模拟带来了复杂的问题。在哈密顿量的电部分（electric part）简单的基中，磁部分（magnetic part）通常表示为格点上plaquette算符之和，因而相当复杂，会在多个链接与格点自由度之间产生关联跃迁。我们在irrep基（不可约表示基，irreducible representation basis）下对plaquette算符提供了一种高效的块编码（block encoding），该基是电基（electric basis）的细化，其中内部的规范可变自由度已被积掉。这一构造移除了plaquette矩阵元标度墙（matrix element scaling wall），而后者在此基下一直是其他方法所面临的重大障碍。该算法利用了矩阵元便捷的因子分解性质、廉价的经典预计算，以及由查找表（lookup table）和可编程旋转（programmed rotations）构建的量子oracle。

Abstract

Gauge theories like lattice QCD present a complex problem for quantum simulation. In a basis where the electric part of the Hamiltonian is simple, the magnetic part, generally expressed as a sum over the plaquette operators of the lattice, is quite complicated, producing correlated transitions between several link and site degrees of freedom. We provide an efficient block encoding of the plaquette operator in the irrep basis, a refinement of the electric basis where the internal gauge-variant degrees of freedom are integrated out. The construction removes the plaquette matrix element scaling wall which has been a significant barrier for other approaches in this basis. The algorithm leverages a convenient factorization property of the matrix elements, cheap classical precomputation, and quantum oracles built from lookup tables and programmed rotations.

摘要翻译

单粒子模式的最优选择导致对不可区分粒子体系多体波函数的基于张量网络的最优压缩，这种压缩对于大型、接近临界的体系至关重要。所提出的模式优化依赖于块熵面积的极小化，这是一个沿一维模式链测量波函数纠缠的全局量。将双位点DMRG算法扩展为最近邻模式优化是直接的，但在没有系统性模式重排的情况下表现不佳。此外，在固定秩MPS流形与模式旋转酉群的组合中寻找平稳最优点需要对每个生成元，即每一对双模式对进行优化。本文提出了一种在MPS流形与完整酉群上的系统性联合优化协议，其中每一对双模式对通过精心构造的双量子比特操作序列（包括交换门控制的置换）来访问。对强关联二维费米子晶格模型和多参考Fe$_4$S$_4$过渡金属簇的大规模DMRG模拟表明，该方法快速收敛到最优点，实现低能量和低纠缠。

An optimal choice of single-particle modes leads to an optimal tensor network-based compression of the many-body wave function for systems of indistinguishable particles, which compression can be essential for large, close-to-critical systems. The proposed mode optimization relies on the minimization of the block entropy area, a global quantity that measures entanglement of the wave function along the one-dimensional chain of modes. Extension of the two-site DMRG algorithm by nearest-neighbor mode optimizations is straightforward, but it performs poorly without systematic reordering of modes. Moreover, finding a stationary optimal point in the combination of the fixed-rank MPS manifold and the unitary group of mode rotations requires optimization for every generator, i.e., for every two-mode pair. Here, a systematic joint optimization protocol over the MPS manifold and the full unitary group is presented in which every two-mode pair is accessed by a carefully constructed sequence of two-qubit operations, including swap-gate controlled permutations. Large-scale DMRG simulations of strongly correlated two-dimensional fermionic lattice models and the multireference Fe$_4$S$_4$ transition metal cluster demonstrate rapid convergence towards the optimum, achieving low energy and low entanglement.

摘要翻译

我们考虑一类非酉操作（non-unitary operations），这类操作通常通过投影测量（projective measurement）与酉算子（unitary operators）的组合自然实现。我们通过将系统耦合到无限组辅助态（ancilla states），并利用单一时间无关哈密顿量（time-independent Hamiltonian）进行时间演化，从而在不使用测量的情况下实现这些操作。无限辅助态使主系统能够达到保留初始相位信息的局域稳态。我们证明，这些稳态操作无法描述为时间无关Lindblad方程（Lindblad equation）从初始态到稳态的映射。作为额外的控制维度，我们展示了系统与辅助态之间的谱共振（spectral resonance）起到开关作用，决定了操作的开启与关闭，并导出一个闭式解析表达式来量化该开关的锐度。数值研究进一步表明，在由辅助态尺寸决定的时间窗口内，相位保持能在中等无序条件下依然成立。因此，这一哈密顿量框架为自主量子控制（autonomous quantum control）提供了超越标准时间无关耗散工程（dissipative engineering）能力的途径。

Abstract

We consider a class of non-unitary operations that is naturally implemented via a combination of projective measurement and unitary operators. We implement these operations without using measurements by coupling the system to an infinite set of ancilla states and time-evolving with a single time-independent Hamiltonian. The infinite ancilla enables the main system to reach a local steady state that preserves initial phase information. We prove that these steady state operations are not describable as a mapping from initial to steady state of a time-independent Lindblad equation. As an additional degree of control, we show that the spectral resonance between the system and the ancilla acts as a switch that turns the operation on and off, and we derive a closed-form expression that quantifies the sharpness of this switch. We further find numerically that the phase preservation survives moderate disorder, over a time window set by the size of the ancilla. This Hamiltonian framework therefore provides a route to autonomous quantum control beyond what standard time-independent dissipative engineering can achieve.

摘要翻译

高阶拓扑绝缘体是一类具有体能量隙的材料，其特征是在$(d-n)$维边界上存在无隙模式，其中$n > 1$。尽管这种修正的体-边界对应关系有所不同，但其非平凡拓扑仍可通过二分纠缠谱观察到。受关于守恒量涨落可用于研究一维系统拓扑的启发——一维系统同样具有零维边界模式——我们将这一处理方法扩展到二维二阶拓扑绝缘体，其中角态扮演类似角色。我们表明，标准的二分纠缠熵和粒子数涨落在静态情形以及淬火后的时间演化中均缺乏拓扑相变的显著信号，这些信号被子系统边界产生的面积律项所掩盖。通过引入子系统的四部分构造，我们证明可以分离出拓扑贡献，在两种量中产生尖锐的跃迁峰，且可通过研究远小于整个系统的子系统进行观测。由于粒子数涨落在现有实验中可及，这些结果为高阶拓扑绝缘体中纠缠的实验探测建立了一条具体且可扩展的路径。

Abstract

Higher-order topological insulators are materials with a bulk energy gap featuring gapless modes at $(d-n)$-dimensional edges, where $n > 1$. Despite this modified bulk-boundary correspondence, their nontrivial topology can nevertheless be observed through the bipartite entanglement spectrum. Inspired by works suggesting fluctuations in conserved quantities could be used to study topology in one-dimensional systems, which likewise feature zero-dimensional edge modes, we extend this treatment to a two-dimensional second-order topological insulator where corner states play an analogous role. We show that the standard bipartite entanglement entropy and particle number fluctuation lack striking signals of topological phase transitions, both in the static case and in the time evolution after a quench, obscured by an area-law term from the subsystem edges. By introducing a quadripartite construction of the subsystem, we show that it is possible to isolate the topological contributions, producing sharp transition peaks in both quantities, observable by studying subsystems much smaller than the full system. As particle number fluctuations are accessible in existing experiments, these results establish a concrete and scalable path to experimental detection of the entanglement in higher-order topological insulators.

TL;DR: 该论文建立了横向Rydberg blockade作用下两个光子空间关联的理论模型，揭示了横向与纵向关联的不同标度规律，并指出空间光子关联可直接用于测量blockade半径。
摘要翻译

我们提出了一个理论，用于研究里德伯(Rydberg)非线性介质中两个相互作用光子的横向空间动力学。作为已充分研究的一维情形的扩展，我们探索了以里德伯极化激元(Rydberg polaritons)形式传播的光子的纵向与横向关联。我们发现这些关联表现出不同的行为与标度律，其原因在于两个方向上的物理机制根本不同：横向关联由衍射主导，纵向关联由扩散主导。我们构建了一个包含高斯(Gaussian)光束和非均匀原子密度分布的模型，并由此推导出两个方向上关联函数的定量预言。我们进一步证明，传播方程可约化为单个类薛定谔方程(Schrödinger-like equation)，从而获得的近似解得到了完整数值结果的验证。我们的结果表明，横向关联长度主要由阻塞半径(blockade radius)决定，而纵向关联长度受带宽(bandwidth)限制。这些结果将横向里德伯阻塞(Rydberg blockade)确立为一种独特且可测量的关联机制，并表明空间光子关联为直接测量阻塞半径提供了一种方法。

Abstract

We develop a theory of the transverse spatial dynamics of two interacting photons in a Rydberg nonlinear medium. Extending the well-studied one-dimensional case, we explore both longitudinal and transverse correlations of photons propagating as Rydberg polaritons. We identify distinct behaviors and scaling laws for these correlations, arising from fundamentally different mechanisms in the two directions: diffraction for transverse correlations and diffusion for longitudinal correlations. We develop a model incorporating a Gaussian optical beam and an inhomogeneous atomic density distribution, from which we derive quantitative predictions for correlation functions in both directions. We further show that the propagation equations can be reduced to a single Schrödinger-like equation, allowing approximate solutions that are supported by full numerical results. Our findings indicate that the transverse correlation length is determined primarily by the blockade radius, whereas the longitudinal correlation length is limited by bandwidth. These results establish transverse Rydberg blockade as a distinct and measurable correlation mechanism and show that spatial photon correlations provide a direct means of measuring the blockade radius.

Moreover, a discrete time scheme of the measurement-enhanced quantum battery is proposed in a quantum circuit with global and random local operations.

Abstract

We cast a class of spatially extended emitter systems as interacting ensembles tractable in the TWA to show how strong fluctuations shape directionality in cooperative emission from a pumped chain containing tens of thousands of emitters, using a few hundred phase-space variables. Our results offer a unified description of collective dynamics beyond the classical limit for emitter ensembles.

我们推导了在三量子比特系统（three-qubit system）中，所有两两量子比特间的形成纠缠（entanglement of formation）平方之和的一个全局上界。该上界是紧的，且可由如下量子态饱和：该量子态包含一个最大纠缠的量子比特对，并与第三个量子比特无关联。进一步，利用这一关系，可将这三个两体纠缠（bipartite entanglement）映射为三个坐标，使得任意三量子比特态都对应三维空间中的一个点，从而赋予这一全局不等式一个非常自然的几何图像。相应地，动力学演化可解释为该几何空间中的轨迹；我们选取若干代表性的初始态，研究在多种马尔可夫噪声模型（Markovian noise model）下这三个两体纠缠的动力学行为。

Abstract

We derive a global bound on the sum of pairwise squared entanglement of formation in three-qubit systems. The bound is tight and can be saturated by states containing a maximally entangled bipartite pair with an uncorrelated third qubit. Moreover, using this relation, we can map the three bipartite entanglements to three coordinates, such that any three-qubit state corresponds to a point in three-dimensional space, thereby endowing this global inequality with a very natural geometric picture. Accordingly, the dynamical evolution can be interpreted as trajectories in this geometric space; we select representative initial states and investigate the dynamical behavior of the three pairwise entanglements under various Markovian noise models.

理解开放量子系统中的弛豫动力学是非平衡量子物理学的核心问题。这里我们研究了自旋-玻色子模型（spin-boson model）中的量子姆佩巴效应（quantum Mpemba effect）。在弱耦合马尔可夫区域，我们证明该效应的出现在低温下强烈依赖于距离度量的选择：它在迹距离（trace distance）中出现，但在量子相对熵（quantum relative entropy）中却可能消失。超越弱耦合近似，对整个系统-浴动力学的数值精确模拟表明，增大耦合会增强迹距离中的效应，并使该效应在量子相对熵中得到恢复。我们揭示了这一效应的一个简单布洛赫球（Bloch sphere）图像：在激发态半球内，通过旋转相关联且具有相同布洛赫矢量模的状态对，通常会表现出其弛豫顺序的反转。该行为在亚欧姆（sub-Ohmic）、欧姆（Ohmic）和超欧姆（super-Ohmic）浴谱下均具有稳健性。在欧姆和亚欧姆区域，接近临界区时交叉时间受到强烈抑制；而在超欧姆区域，尽管不存在有限耦合局域化转变，该效应仍然增强。这些结果突显了几何结构、距离度量、系统-环境耦合和浴谱性质在反常量子弛豫中的相互作用。

Abstract

Understanding relaxation dynamics in open quantum systems is a central problem in nonequilibrium quantum physics. Here we investigate the quantum Mpemba effect in the spin boson model. In the weak coupling Markovian regime we show that the occurrence of the effect strongly depends on the choice of distance measure at low temperature: while it appears in the trace distance, it can disappear in the quantum relative entropy. Going beyond the weak-coupling approximation, numerically exact simulations of the full system bath dynamics reveal that increasing coupling enhances the effect in the trace distance and restores it in the quantum relative entropy. We uncover a simple Bloch sphere picture of the effect: within the excited-state hemisphere, pairs of states related by rotations and having the same Bloch-vector modulus generically exhibit an inversion of their relaxation ordering. This behavior is robust across sub Ohmic, Ohmic, and super Ohmic bath spectra. In the Ohmic and sub Ohmic regimes, the crossing time becomes strongly suppressed upon approaching the critical region, whereas in the super Ohmic regime the effect remains enhanced despite the absence of a finite-coupling localization transition. These results highlight the interplay between geometry, distance measures, system--environment coupling, and bath spectral properties in anomalous quantum relaxation.

TL;DR: 该论文利用张量网络和矩阵乘积工具，在含噪声条件下大规模模拟哈密顿量学习过程，解析和数值分析了估计误差的稳定性，并成功学习了300位点混合场伊辛模型的哈密顿量。
摘要翻译

学习量子系统的哈密顿量对于理解和控制其动力学至关重要，近年来已成为广泛关注的研究课题。为理解学习协议的误差容限，即在不可避免的误差存在下的稳定性，本工作利用张量网络技术，在含噪且大规模条件下模拟哈密顿量学习流程。具体而言，我们采用一种基于近似稳态的哈密顿量学习方法，该方法利用矩阵乘积工具构造近似稳态。我们给出了哈密顿量学习估计误差的解析界，并进行了数值模拟，揭示了学习误差在两类误差下的稳定性。利用我们的流程，能够将该协议扩展至包含\(N=300\)个格点的一维自旋链混合场伊辛模型哈密顿量的学习。通过大规模模拟协议并实证研究其实际局限性，我们对误差如何影响哈密顿量学习过程的分析为未来实验提供了有价值的经验。最后，我们讨论了本工作开启的研究方向以及未来可支持哈密顿量学习实验的工作。

Abstract

Learning a quantum system's Hamiltonian is crucial for understanding and controlling its dynamics and has recently become a topic of widespread interest. To understand the learning protocol's error tolerances, i.e. its stability in the presence of inevitable errors, this work utilizes tensor network techniques to emulate Hamiltonian learning workflows at scale and with noise. Specifically, we employed a Hamiltonian learning technique based on approximate stationary states which are constructed using matrix product tools. We provide analytic bounds on the Hamiltonian learning estimation errors and perform numerical simulations that highlight learning error's stability under two families of errors. Using our workflow, we are able to scale up the protocol and learn mixed-field Ising model Hamiltonians of an $N=300$ site spin chain. By simulating the protocol at large scale, and empirically studying its practical limitations, our analysis of how errors affect the Hamiltonian learning process provides valuable lessons for future experiments. We conclude by discussing the avenues our work opens as well as future work that can support Hamiltonian learning experiments.

TL;DR: 论文研究了量子增强原子干涉仪中准Bragg衍射与速度选择性之间的竞争，推导了Mach-Zehnder干涉仪包含寄生衍射效应的相位不确定度解析表达式，并证明亚散粒噪声灵敏度仅在中等级脉冲持续时间内可实现。
摘要翻译

原子系综中的自旋压缩（spin squeezing）使原子干涉测量（atom interferometry）能够达到低于散粒噪声极限（shot-noise limit）的灵敏度，但这种纠缠对损耗高度敏感，因而原子光学的不完善性成为核心限制。布拉格衍射（Bragg diffraction）是驱动原子动量态之间跃迁的成熟技术，可在保持内态的同时通过高阶衍射实现大动量转移。然而，它本质上受到两种相互竞争机制的限制：短光脉冲会诱发到非共振级次的寄生衍射，超出有效二能级描述的范畴；长光脉冲则面临速度选择性。我们在二次量子化（second-quantized）框架下，推导了包含上述效应的马赫-曾德尔干涉仪（Mach-Zehnder interferometer）中原子光学与相位不确定度的解析表达式。我们证明，亚散粒噪声标度（sub-shot-noise scaling）仅在中等脉冲持续时间区间内才能实现。此外，我们表明，高阶衍射的不利效应可通过优化输入量子态而得到部分抑制。

Abstract

Spin squeezing in atomic ensembles enables atom interferometry with sensitivities below the shot-noise limit, but the associated entanglement is highly susceptible to loss, making imperfections in atom optics a central limitation. Bragg diffraction is an established technique for driving transitions between atomic momentum states and enables large-momentum transfer through higher-order diffraction while preserving the internal state. However, it is intrinsically limited by two competing mechanisms: Short light pulses induce parasitic diffraction into off-resonant orders beyond an effective two-level description, while long pulses face velocity selectivity. We derive analytical expressions in a second-quantized framework for the atom optics and phase uncertainty of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer including these effects. We demonstrate that sub-shot-noise scaling is achieved only in a regime of intermediate pulse duration. Furthermore, we show that deleterious effects of higher-order diffraction are partially mitigated by optimizing the input quantum state.

摘要翻译

Res. 7, 043318 (2025)] 的近期量子动力学研究相同的网格与问题规模下，将其与该研究中求解一维对流扩散方程所用的 Trotter 化、变分量子虚时演化及自适应变分量子动力学模拟等方法进行了基准对比。在无噪声的态矢量模拟器上，当电路深度达到 L≈5 时，N=4 的 VQE 即将末时刻不保真度压低至数值下限（~10⁻¹⁴）；在期望值精确计算的条件下，该数值下限也就是其算法层面的性能上限。如果在仍然没有硬件噪声的情况下，仅以有限的 S 次测量样本来评估同一个求解器，其不保真度将变为采样受限，满足 1−f≈c/S（这是在假定解的正负号已知时对读出采样的最优情形估计）。由此得到的标度关系可与 Alipanah 等人基于采样的仿真器在匹配的采样区间内进行对照，同时也解释了他们的带噪硬件运行结果（>10⁻¹）为何会偏离这种无硬件噪声的采样受限预期。该基准测试因而将近期算法的误差预算分解为算法贡献、采样贡献和硬件贡献，并提供了匹配电路深度下的资源比较。上述框架无需任何修改即可适用于 N=4、5、6 个量子比特，也可用于一个演化到 t=1 的二维（八量子比特，16×16）问题。在该二维问题中，态矢量模拟下的 VQE 可使不保真度保持在约 10⁻⁷ 的算法上限水平，而相应的基于采样的模拟则受采样限制，约为 10⁻⁵；二者的差异来自测量方式的不同，而非算法上的优劣。

Abstract

Near-term quantum algorithms are a promising route to solving partial differential equations, but gauging their true potential requires separating algorithmic performance from sampling and hardware noise. We benchmark a ground-state variational quantum eigensolver (VQE), cast as a variational quantum linear solver, against the Trotterization, variational quantum imaginary time evolution, and adaptive variational quantum dynamics simulation methods applied to the one-dimensional advection-diffusion equation in the recent quantum-dynamics study by Alipanah et al. [Phys. Rev. Res. 7, 043318 (2025)] at matched grid and problem size. On a noiseless state-vector simulator the $N=4$ VQE drives the final-time infidelity to a numerical floor ($\sim\!10^{-14}$) once the depth reaches $L\approx5$, an \emph{algorithmic ceiling} set by exact expectation values. Evaluating the same solver with a finite number $S$ of measurement shots, still without hardware noise, makes the infidelity sampling limited, following $1-f\approx c/S$ (a best-case readout-sampling estimate, with the solution's signs assumed known), providing a regime-matched comparison with the shot-based emulator of Alipanah \emph{et al.}\ and explaining the gap to their noisy hardware runs ($>10^{-1}$). The benchmark thus decomposes the near-term error budget into algorithmic, sampling, and hardware contributions, with a matched-depth resource comparison. The formulation applies without modification across $N=4,5,6$ qubits and to a two-dimensional (eight-qubit, $16\times16$) problem evolved to $t=1$, where the state-vector VQE holds a $\sim\!10^{-7}$ algorithmic-ceiling infidelity against the sampling-limited $\sim\!10^{-5}$ of the corresponding shot-based simulation, a difference of measurement regime rather than algorithmic superiority.

摘要翻译

部分转置（partial-transpose, PT）矩是从局域 Pauli 经典阴影（local Pauli classical shadows）中可获取的最具实际意义的非线性量之一，因为它们直接支撑了混合态纠缠认证以及近期基于 PT 矩的相位诊断。Marso 等人的在线框架将精确的 PT 矩统计量改写为一个固定内存的递推：每接收一个新的阴影快照，便更新少量累加矩阵。其更新成本与 shot 数无关，但每一步都将新到达的部分转置快照视为普通稠密矩阵，因此算术成本随希尔伯特空间维数呈三次方增长。我们证明，在保持相同内存占用的前提下，同一估计量可以在每次 shot 中以次立方时间被精确更新。关键在于：累加矩阵虽然会变稠密，但新到的部分转置快照仍可分解为局域因子；因此，右乘该分解形式的快照可以通过精确的列对扫描来完成。对于二阶 PT 矩，我们进一步利用泡利基更新对该过程进行了优化。

Abstract

Partial-transpose (PT) moments are among the most practically relevant nonlinear quantities accessible from local Pauli classical shadows, because they directly underpin mixed-state entanglement certification and recent PT-moment-based phase diagnostics. The online framework of Marso \emph{et al.} rewrote the exact PT-moment statistic into a fixed-memory recurrence that updates a small collection of accumulated matrices after each new shadow snapshot. Its update cost is independent of the shot number, but each step treats the incoming partially transposed snapshot as a generic dense matrix. Therefore, the arithmetic cost scales cubically with the dimension of the Hilbert space. We show that the same estimator can be updated exactly in subcubic time per shot while retaining the same memory. The key point is that the accumulated matrices become dense, but the fresh partially transposed snapshot still factorizes into local factors. Right-multiplication by that factorized snapshot can therefore be executed by exact column-pair sweeps. For the second PT moment, we further optimize the process by utilizing a Pauli basis update.

摘要翻译

量子相干性是一种基本的量子资源，其在环境相互作用下的保持对于量子信息处理至关重要。尽管大多数研究集中于依赖于基底的相干性度量，但由不依赖于基底的度量所量化的内禀相干性的动力学在很大程度上尚未被探索。在本工作中，我们研究了若干代表性的三体纯态和混合态在马尔可夫与非马尔可夫机制下分别经受局域和共同退相位环境时的基底无关量子相干性动力学。我们表明，马尔可夫局域退相位导致依赖态的相干性衰减，而集体退相位则通过无退相干子空间显著增强相干性保持。更重要的是，非马尔可夫环境对纯态和混合态均产生近乎冻结的相干性动力学，展示了内禀相干性对退相位环境的显著鲁棒性。与相对熵相干性度量的比较揭示，基底无关的相干性度量表现出远高于其基底依赖对应物的韧性，并呈现定性不同的动力学行为。这些结果为开放量子系统中内禀多体相干性的保持提供了新见解，并凸显了基底无关相干性作为现实有噪量子技术中一种鲁棒量子资源的潜力。

Abstract

Quantum coherence is a fundamental quantum resource whose preservation under environmental interactions is essential for quantum information processing. While most studies have focused on basis-dependent coherence measures, the dynamics of intrinsic coherence quantified by basis-independent measures remain largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the dynamics of basis-independent quantum coherence for several representative tripartite pure and mixed states subjected to local and common dephasing environments in both Markovian and non-Markovian regimes. We show that Markovian local dephasing leads to state-dependent coherence degradation, whereas collective dephasing significantly enhances coherence preservation through decoherence-free sectors. More importantly, non-Markovian environments give rise to nearly frozen coherence dynamics for both pure and mixed states, demonstrating the remarkable robustness of intrinsic coherence against dephasing environment. A comparison with the measure of relative entropy of coherence reveals that basis-independent coherence measure exhibits substantially greater resilience and qualitatively different dynamical behaviour than its basis-dependent counterpart. These results provide new insights into the preservation of intrinsic multipartite coherence in open quantum systems and highlight basis-independent coherence as a robust quantum resource for realistic noisy quantum technologies.

摘要翻译

噪声环境下的纠缠多量子比特态相位传感是现代量子计量学的核心主题。本文研究了在单体和两体相互作用哈密顿量所产生的参数编码下的Dicke态叠加探针，用于量子相位传感。在线性集体自旋编码下，与Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger (GHZ)态、W叠加态及平衡Dicke态相比，近最优Dicke叠加态显示出对相位阻尼噪声显著增强的鲁棒性，并在实际退相干信道中保持良好的计量性能。针对两体相互作用，确定了使量子Fisher信息最大化的最优探针态，并分析了其在相位阻尼、振幅阻尼及全局退极化信道下的噪声鲁棒性和计量标度行为。对于所考虑的系统尺寸，相应的近最优Dicke叠加态被发现对相位阻尼具有更好的鲁棒性。这些结果确立了定制的近最优Dicke态叠加探针作为一种多功能、抗噪声的资源，适用于由单体和两体相互作用支配的海森堡和超海森堡量子相位传感。

Abstract

Phase sensing with entangled multi-qubit states in the presence of noise is a central theme of modern quantum metrology. The present work investigates Dicke state superposition probes for quantum phase sensing under parameter encoding generated by one- and two-body interaction Hamiltonians. Under linear collective-spin encoding, near-optimal Dicke superposition states are shown to exhibit significantly enhanced robustness against phase damping noise compared with Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger (GHZ), W-superposition, and balanced Dicke states, while maintaining favorable metrological performance under realistic decoherence channels. For two-body interactions, optimal probe states maximizing the quantum Fisher information are identified. Their noise resilience and metrological scaling behaviour under phase damping, amplitude damping, and global depolarizing channels are analyzed. The associated near-optimal Dicke superposition states are found to exhibit improved resilience to phase damping, for the system sizes considered. These results establish tailored near-optimal Dicke state superposition probes as versatile and noise-resilient resources for Heisenberg and super-Heisenberg quantum phase sensing governed by one- and two-body interactions.

摘要翻译

我们利用Unruh-DeWitt探测器模型研究相对论运动下四量子比特Dicke态中四体纠缠的行为，其中一个探测器经历匀加速运动。我们证明该纠缠表现出非单调演化：随着加速度增大，它先下降后上升并趋于有限值。与Unruh效应导致多体纠缠单调退化的传统观点相反，我们的结果表明，在有限参数区间内Unruh效应反而能够增强多体纠缠。这一行为揭示了Unruh效应在多体系统中的双重作用。因此，我们的发现提供了对相对论多体量子关联的更精细理解，表明Dicke态是抵抗Unruh诱导退相干更为鲁棒的多体量子资源，并可能为相对论量子信息处理任务提供优势。

Abstract

We investigate the behavior of tetrapartite entanglement in a four-qubit Dicke state under relativistic motion by employing the Unruh-DeWitt detector model, where one detector undergoes uniform acceleration. We show that the entanglement exhibits a non-monotonic evolution: it first decreases and subsequently increases toward a finite value as the acceleration grows. In contrast to the conventional view that the Unruh effect leads to a monotonic degradation of multipartite entanglement, our results demonstrate that it can instead enhance multipartite entanglement within a finite parameter regime. This behavior reveals a dual role of the Unruh effect in multipartite systems. Our findings therefore provide a refined understanding of relativistic multipartite quantum correlations, indicating that Dicke states constitute more robust multipartite quantum resources against Unruh-induced decoherence and may offer advantages for relativistic quantum information processing tasks.

摘要翻译

我们提出了一种受经典影子层析启发的变分方案，用于计算量子自旋哈密顿量的基态关联。影子层析能够从对状态 \( \rho \) 的副本进行重复、随机化测量所得到的一袋快照（snapshots）中高效重构任意可观测量的期望值。该方案表明，当在局部随机基下进行测量时，仅需 \( N \sim 3^k \log M / \varepsilon^2 \) 个快照，即可将 \( M \) 个 \( k \)-局域可观测量的期望值重构至精度 \( \varepsilon \)。反过来，一袋快照可视为状态 \( \rho \) 的一种高效表示，尤其适用于估计低权重可观测量，例如估算能量所需的局域哈密顿量中的各项。受此启发，我们考虑一种变分方案，其中用一袋 \( N \) 个参数化的快照来表示所需局域自旋哈密顿量的候选基态，并通过优化降低其能量。此外，受量子化学工作启发，我们加入了约化密度矩阵正定性的约束，以确保预测的关联与底层希尔伯特空间相容。尽管所施加的约束集合有限，我们表明优化后的快照集合仍能相当准确地估计基态能量及其他关联，包括那些未出现在优化约束集合中的量。

Abstract

We introduce a variational scheme inspired by classical shadow tomography to compute ground state correlations of quantum spin Hamiltonians. Shadow tomography allows for efficient reconstruction of expectation values of arbitrary observables from a bag of repeated, randomized measurements, called snapshots, on copies of the state $ρ$. The prescription allows one to infer expectation values of $M$ $k-$local observables to accuracy $ε$ using just $N \sim 3^k \text{log}M /ε^2$ snapshots when measurements are performed in locally random bases. Turning this around, a bag of snapshots can be considered an efficient representation of the state $ρ$, particularly for estimating low-weight observables, such as terms in a local Hamiltonian needed to estimate the energy. Inspired by this, we consider a variational scheme wherein a bag of $N$ parametrized snapshots is used to represent the putative ground state of a desired local spin Hamiltonian and optimized to lower the energy with respect to it. Additional constraints in the form of positivity of reduced density matrices, motivated by work in quantum chemistry, are employed to ensure compatibility of the predicted correlations with the underlying Hilbert space. Despite the limited set of imposed constraints, we show that the optimized ensemble of snapshots yields fairly accurate estimates of the ground state energy and other correlations, including those that do not appear in the set of constraints used in optimization.

Published: 2026-07-15
Version: v2
TL;DR: 在离子阱处理器上实验实现了三角函数连续变量量子门，并揭示了其Wigner负性的非微扰特性，为玻色子量子模拟提供了可控的构建模块。
摘要翻译

我们在离子阱处理器（trapped-ion processor）上实验实现了三角连续变量门（trigonometric continuous-variable gates），其中运动模式（motional mode）获得的相位正比于其位置正交量（position quadrature）的余弦；并首次实现了双模推广，即通过单个非线性相位将两个模式耦合起来。这类门为作用于紧致与非紧致自由度的周期相互作用提供了一种实验上可及的非多项式基本单元，适用于转子模型（rotor model）、正弦-戈登型系统（sine-Gordon-type system）和格点规范理论（lattice gauge theory）。通过扫描门强度、空间频率和电路深度，我们利用蓝边带光谱技术（blue-sideband spectroscopy）解析了标志精确余弦演化的宇称选择定则（parity selection rule），并发现包含残余热占据和运动退相位的开放系统模型（open-system model）能够重现数据。随后，我们推导了这些门产生的维格纳负性（Wigner negativity）的渐近行为，发现了三个标度区间：当负值区域位于相空间远尾部时，负性随门强度的变化超越所有代数阶；一旦这些区域进入主体区域，负性变为线性，并饱和于我们建立的一阶界限；而在强门强度下则呈对数行为。这些结果揭示了一种普遍机制（通过余弦门首次辨识）：即使非高斯资源本身非零，其任何有限阶微扰估计都可能消失为零。总的来说，我们的结果确立了三角门可作为一种可控且实验上可实现的玻色子量子模拟构建模块，扩展了连续变量量子处理器可访问的非线性动力学类别。

Abstract

We experimentally realize trigonometric continuous-variable gates on a trapped-ion processor, for which a motional mode acquires a phase proportional to the cosine of its position quadrature, and, for the first time, implement the two-mode generalization, coupling two modes through a single nonlinear phase. Such gates provide an experimentally accessible, nonpolynomial primitive for periodic interactions acting on both compact and noncompact degrees of freedom, including rotor models, sine-Gordon-type systems, and lattice gauge theories. Scanning gate strength, spatial frequency, and circuit depth, we resolve via blue-sideband spectroscopy the parity selection rule that fingerprints the exact cosine evolution, and find that an open-system model incorporating residual thermal occupation and motional dephasing reproduces the data. We then derive the asymptotics of the Wigner negativity generated by these gates and find three scaling regimes. The negativity is beyond all algebraic orders in the gate strength while the negative regions sit in far phase-space tails, becomes linear once they reach the bulk, where it saturates a first-order bound we establish, and logarithmic at strong gate strength. These results expose a general mechanism, first identified here through the cosine gate, by which every finite-order perturbative estimate of a non-Gaussian resource can vanish even though the resource itself remains nonzero. Together, our results establish trigonometric gates as controllable, experimentally realizable building blocks for bosonic quantum simulation, expanding the class of nonlinear dynamics accessible to continuous-variable quantum processors.

摘要翻译

我们以精确可解的1+1维大N_c QCD的t Hooft模型作为严格实验平台，研究因果响应函数——介子两点函数——解析性破坏的机制。对光锥介子算符施加PT对称形变iγ(x−1/2)，即虚化学势的类比，使最低两个介子驱动到γ_c处的奇异点(EP)。将预解式重构为Jacobi连分数，得到γ_c的闭式表达式：在两极点水平为2πg²N_c，并收敛至深度五时的7.966g²N_c——这是一个解析而非数值的阈值。平方根指数ν=1/2由2×2 Jordan标准形固定，并通过N=1999的有限尺寸标度得到确认。该破坏具有明确的时间域特征：传播子范数在γ<γ_c时有界，在γ_c处线性增长（Jordan久期律），在超过γ_c时指数增长——由于形变算符是非厄米Wannier-Stark梯子，这一现象可在光子与拓扑电路类比中观测。该阈值与禁闭锁定，满足γ_c∝g²N_c，并以均匀奇异点级联形式重现；另一种非互易形变则产生精确指数的非厄米趋肤效应。这是禁闭规范理论中首个解析可控的奇异点解析性破坏实例。

Abstract

We use the exactly-solvable t Hooft model of 1+1D large-N_c QCD as a rigorous laboratory for the breakdown of analyticity of a causal response function, the meson two-point function. A PT-symmetric deformation i gamma(x-1/2) of the light-cone meson operator, the analogue of an imaginary chemical potential, drives the lowest two mesons to an exceptional point (EP) at gamma_c. Recasting the resolvent as a Jacobi continued fraction yields gamma_c in closed form: 2 pi g^2 N_c at the two-pole level, converging to 7.966 g^2 N_c by depth five -- an analytic, not numerical, threshold. The square-root exponent nu=1/2 is fixed by the 2x2 Jordan form and confirmed by finite-size scaling to N=1999. The breakdown has an unambiguous time-domain signature: the propagator norm is bounded for gamma < gamma_c, grows linearly at gamma_c (the Jordan secular law), and exponentially beyond -- observable, since the deformed operator is a non-Hermitian Wannier-Stark ladder, in photonic and topolectrical analogues. The threshold is locked to confinement, gamma_c propto g^2 N_c, and recurs as a uniform EP cascade; a second, non-reciprocal deformation yields an exactly-exponential non-Hermitian skin effect. This is the first analytically-controlled instance of exceptional-point analyticity breakdown in a confining gauge theory.

摘要翻译

在子系统损失之后恢复量子信息，是量子信息处理中的一个核心挑战。然而，有些量子态是任何恢复策略都无法触及的。在此，我们确定了虚拟不可恢复性（virtual irrecoverability）的代数起源——“幽灵信息”（ghost information），即编码在全局态中但在任何可访问子系统上都不留痕迹的关联。我们引入一个标量度量来量化其大小，并证明了一个普适误差下限（universal error floor）：无论投入多少资源，任何虚拟恢复映射（virtual recovery map）都无法使误差降至该下限以下。在这种情况下，只能进行近似的虚拟恢复。我们研究了逼近最小可达到恢复误差时的采样成本，发现当底层线性映射具有谱隙（spectrum gap）时该成本有界，而在无隙情形下则发散。这种二分性与普适误差下限相结合，将所有多体量子态划分为四类。此外，我们还证明了条件互信息（conditional mutual information）——标准的熵诊断量——并不约束虚拟可恢复性。作为推论，该误差下限为容损量子计量学（loss-tolerant quantum metrology）施加了一个探测阈值。

Abstract

The recovery of quantum information after subsystem loss is a central challenge in quantum information processing. However, some states remain beyond the reach of any recovery strategies. Here we identify the algebraic origin of virtual irrecoverability, the \emph{ghost information}---correlations encoded in the global state that leave no trace on any accessible subsystem. We introduce a scalar measure quantifying its magnitude and prove a universal error floor below which no virtual recovery map can operate, irrespective of resource investment. In such cases only \emph{approximate} virtual recovery is available. We study the sampling cost when approaching the minimal attainable recovery error, and find it bounded when the underlying linear map exhibits a spectrum gap, and divergent in the gapless regime, respectively. Together with the universal error floor, this dichotomy partitions all multipartite quantum states into four classes. Moreover, we show that conditional mutual information, the standard entropic diagnostic, does not constrain virtual recoverability. As an implication, we show that the error floor imposes a detection threshold for loss-tolerant quantum metrology.

摘要翻译

系统的Rabi振幅误差与失谐误差仍然是高保真量子门中非保真度（infidelity）的重要来源。我们将逆向工程与含时微扰分析相结合，针对三能级Λ型qutrit中的非绝热全息量子计算（non-adiabatic holonomic quantum computing, NHQC）提出了一种鲁棒的脉冲工程方案。脉冲整形可消除Rabi振幅误差的领头二阶贡献；但静态失谐会引入一个独特的由布居数介导的误差通道，该通道无法在单一控制回路内消除。为此，我们进一步引入一个补偿回路，以精确抵消占主导的二阶$O_{13}^{\delta}$贡献，并通过脉冲整形进一步抑制残余的$O_{12}^{\delta}$通道。利用完整计算子空间上的逻辑平均门保真度，在$\varepsilon=0.2$、$\delta/2\pi=2~\mathrm{MHz}$条件下，优化后的复合序列对四种代表性单比特门达到$99.88\%$–$99.99\%$的闭合系统保真度。在$T_1=T_2=30~\mu\mathrm{s}$的现象学退相干情形下，NOT门与S门分别保持$99.72\%$和$99.79\%$的保真度，相干时间交叉点约在$0.58~\mu\mathrm{s}$处。这些结果界定了系统性误差抑制的收益超过附加控制回路所带来退相干代价的参数区间。

Abstract

Systematic Rabi-amplitude and detuning errors remain important sources of infidelity in high-fidelity quantum gates. We develop a robust pulse-engineering scheme for non-adiabatic holonomic quantum computing in a three-level $Λ$-type qutrit, combining inverse engineering with time-dependent perturbative analysis. Pulse shaping eliminates the leading second-order Rabi-amplitude contribution, while static detuning introduces a distinct population-mediated channel that cannot be removed within a single control loop. We therefore introduce a compensation loop that exactly cancels the dominant second-order $O_{13}^δ$ contribution, with the residual $O_{12}^δ$ channel further suppressed by pulse shaping. Using the logical average gate fidelity over the complete computational subspace, the optimized composite sequence reaches closed-system fidelities of $99.88\%$--$99.99\%$ for four representative single-qubit gates at $ε=0.2$ and $δ/2π=2$ MHz. With phenomenological decoherence at $T_1=T_2=30~μ{\rm s}$, the NOT and S gates retain fidelities of $99.72\%$ and $99.79\%$, respectively, with a coherence-time crossover near $0.58~μ{\rm s}$. These results identify the regime in which systematic-error suppression outweighs the decoherence cost of the additional control loop.

摘要翻译

随着新兴量子架构演化为结合不同物理载体的异构网络，例如将用于逻辑运算的量子比特（qubit）和用于稳健通信的高维量子比特（qudit）相结合，量子纠错中传统的标量度量已显不足。针对这一问题，我们提出了一种基于维度多重集的数学框架，用以刻画混合维度希尔伯特空间中的量子纠错码（QECC）与绝对最大纠缠（AME）态。通过用多重集替代标量权重，我们能够精确捕获这些多样系统中错误支撑集的物理构成。本文的核心结果是混合维度量子MacWilliams恒等式，它确立了Shor-Laflamme枚举式与酉权重枚举式之间的形式代数关系。在此基础上，我们推导出混合维度shadow恒等式，并获得严格且更具一般性的码参数约束；具体明确了混合维度量子Hamming界、Singleton界和Scott界，同时设计了线性规划方法以系统评估码的可行性。针对Singleton界，我们还为纯混合维度码推导出一个更紧的界，该界在齐次维度码中没有对应版本。最后，我们运用上述枚举机制全面分析AME态，借助shadow不等式约束其存在性，并引入了一种组合网格方法，用于显式构造混合维度三方AME态。

Abstract

As emerging quantum architectures evolve into heterogeneous networks combining different physical substrates, such as qubits for logic and higher-dimensional qudits for robust communication, the traditional scalar metrics of quantum error correction become insufficient. To address this, we introduce a mathematical framework based on dimension multisets to characterize quantum error-correcting codes (QECC) and absolutely maximally entangled (AME) states in mixed-dimensional Hilbert spaces. By replacing scalar weights with multisets, we accurately capture the exact physical composition of error supports across these diverse systems. Our central result is the mixed-dimensional quantum MacWilliams identity, which establishes the formal algebraic relationship between Shor-Laflamme enumerators and unitary weight enumerators. From this foundation, we deduce the mixed-dimensional shadow identity and derive rigorous, generalized constraints on code parameters, explicitly formulating the mixed-dimensional quantum Hamming, Singleton and Scott bounds, and developing a linear program to systematically evaluate code viability. For the Singleton bound, a tighter bound that has no homogeneous analogue is derived for pure mixed-dimensional codes. Finally, we deploy this enumerator machinery to thoroughly analyze AME states, utilizing shadow inequalities to constrain their existence and introducing a combinatorial grid method for the explicit construction of mixed-dimensional tripartite AME states.

Abstract

Standard universal quantum computing using exchange-only qubits typically requires three physical spins per logical qubit, leading to significant hardware overhead. Conversely, two-spin units offer higher density but rely on local magnetic field gradients for control, increasing integration complexity. In this paper, we propose a resource-efficient quantum machine learning (QML) architecture that achieves high expressibility using minimal two-spin units and Heisenberg exchange interactions alone, without any magnetic gradients. We shift the paradigm from universal gate-based control to utilizing the intrinsic, time-domain dynamics of a spin chain as a learning resource. Numerical simulations on MNIST digit classification demonstrate that the symmetry-protected constraints of isolated spin pairs are bypassed by leveraging inter-pair exchange coupling. This interference-mediated state mixing significantly enhances the expressibility of the Hilbert space. The model reaches a test-set accuracy of 90.9% +/- 0.2% over five independent seeds on the full 10,000-image MNIST test set. Under an identical linear readout, the trained quantum feature map (88.1%) clearly outperforms a classical linear baseline on the same PCA inputs (83.2%) as well as an untrained (reservoir-style) version of the same dynamics (53.0%), demonstrating that the learned, input-dependent exchange pulses implement a genuinely non-linear and trainable feature map. The protocol is also robust to experimentally relevant imperfections: accuracy remains at 89.9% under 10% quasi-static pulse-area noise and at 89.8% when every observable is estimated from 10^3 measurement shots. These findings suggest that competitive QML can be executed on the simplest possible semiconductor spin-chain hardware, bypassing the need for leakage-prone encodings or complex micro-magnet integration.

摘要翻译

虽然纠缠态矢量无法完全用定位于空间和时间的变量来描述，但任何给定的纠缠实验都可以由具有明确位置的量子电路基本组件构建而成。我们分析此类量子电路，并提出证据表明，局域弱值(weak values)构成与每个独立量子比特(qubit)相关联的协变张量。即使态是高度纠缠的，这些张量在其他量子比特被测量或通过远处的电路元件时，既不会演化也不会坍缩。因此，它们可以从不同参考系(reference frames)进行观察而无矛盾。此外，它们在任何电路中的演化始终遵循协变动力学规则。弱值同时受到过去和未来条件的约束，因此协变量只能通过"一次性"(all-at-once)考虑整个电路来确定，一如作用量原理(action principles)的做法，将未来测量基纳入考量，以避免标准的不可行定理(no-go theorems)。由于这些结果适用于一套普适量子门(quantum gates)，本研究支持如下主张：任何量子电路都可以被赋予一种实在论的、更低层次的描述，且该描述与我们对经典时空的理解相容。

Abstract

Although entangled state vectors cannot be fully described in terms of variables localized in space and time, any given entanglement experiment can be built from basic quantum circuit components with well-defined locations. We analyze such quantum circuits and present evidence that the local weak values comprise a covariant tensor associated with each individual qubit. Even if the state is massively entangled, these tensors do not evolve or collapse when other qubits are measured or pass through distant circuit elements. They can therefore be viewed from different reference frames without contradiction. Furthermore, their evolution through any circuit always obeys covariant dynamical rules. Weak values are subject to both past and future constraints, so the covariant quantities can only be determined by considering the entire circuit "all-at-once", as in action principles, incorporating the future measurement basis to avoid the standard no-go theorems. Because these results hold for a set of universal quantum gates, this work lends support to the claim that any quantum circuit can be assigned a realistic, lower-level description compatible with our understanding of classical spacetime.

The benchmark includes local, stochastic-gradient, evolutionary, covariance-adaptation, and swarm-based optimization methods under matched function-evaluation budgets. To understand their performance beyond final energies, we characterize the underlying Hamiltonian--ansatz landscapes in terms of local minima, gradients, curvature, and ground-state reachability. These results show how classical optimization, variational expressivity, and landscape geometry jointly determine VQE performance for frustrated spin models.

摘要翻译

Qudit（多能级量子信息载体）为扩展量子计算机提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，其使用带来了量子逻辑中更高的复杂度，要求对不同qudit能级间的相对相位进行精细控制。在离子阱系统中，纠缠操作会在特定能级上积累不再全局化的相位，这与qubit（量子比特）架构不同。此外，多能级门结构随希尔伯特空间维度的升高而日趋复杂。本工作探索了在Mølmer–Sørensen门和光移（Light-shift）门中积累的这些额外局域与非局域相位的理论。我们提出了主动补偿这些相位、增强门对参数波动的鲁棒性，并简化原生门以实现更高效电路分解的方法。我们的结果为基于qudit的量子处理器的实用化和可扩展实现铺平了道路。

Abstract

Qudits, or multi-level quantum information carriers, present a promising path for scaling quantum computers. However, their use introduces increased complexity in quantum logic, necessitating careful control of relative phases between different qudit levels. In trapped-ion systems, entangling operations accumulate phases on specific levels that are no longer global, unlike in qubit architectures. Furthermore, the structure of multi-level gates becomes increasingly intricate with higher-dimensional Hilbert spaces. This work explores the theory of these additional local and nonlocal phases, accumulated in Mølmer--Sørensen and Light-shift gates. We propose methods to actively compensate for these phases, enhance gate robustness against parameter fluctuations, and simplify native gates for more efficient circuit decomposition. Our results pave the way toward the practical and scalable implementation of qudit-based quantum processors.

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种张量网络框架，通过谱收敛逼近Koopman生成元并提升到Fock空间，实现对保测遍历系统可观测量演化的正性保持近似。
摘要翻译

我们提出了一个用于逼近保测遍历系统可观测量演化的张量网络框架。我们的方法基于对斜伴随Koopman生成元的光谱收敛逼近，通过一个可对角化的斜伴随算子\(W_\tau\)作用在再生核Hilbert空间\(\mathcal H_\tau\)上，该空间具有余代数结构和在函数逐点乘法下的Banach代数结构。利用这一结构，我们将酉演化算子\(e^{t W_\tau}\)（可视为正则化的Koopman算子）提升到由\(\mathcal H_\tau\)生成的Fock空间\(F(\mathcal H_\tau)\)上的酉演化群，该群关于张量积具有乘法性。我们的方案还采用了经典可观测量（状态的\(L^\infty\)函数）由作用在Fock空间上的量子可观测量（自伴算子）表示，以及\(L^1\)中的概率密度由量子态表示。结合这些构造，我们得到了Koopman可观测演化的一种逼近，该逼近可表示为在任意高阶\(n \in \mathbb N\)的张量积子空间\(\mathcal H_\tau^{\otimes n} \subset F(\mathcal H_\tau)\)上构建的树张量网络的求值。这种量子启发的逼近的一个关键特征是，它从由\(W_\tau\)的\(2d+1\)个特征函数生成的维度为\((2d+1)^n\)的张量积空间中捕获信息。此外，该逼近保持正性。本文包含了该方法的理论收敛性分析，以及两个二维环上动力系统的数值应用：一个遍历环面旋转作为纯点Koopman谱的例子，和一个Stepanoff流作为拓扑弱混合的例子。

Abstract

We propose a tensor network framework for approximating the evolution of observables of measure-preserving ergodic systems. Our approach is based on a spectrally-convergent approximation of the skew-adjoint Koopman generator by a diagonalizable, skew-adjoint operator $W_τ$ that acts on a reproducing kernel Hilbert space $\mathcal H_τ$ with coalgebra structure and Banach algebra structure under the pointwise product of functions. Leveraging this structure, we lift the unitary evolution operators $e^{t W_τ}$ (which can be thought of as regularized Koopman operators) to a unitary evolution group on the Fock space $F(\mathcal H_τ)$ generated by $\mathcal H_τ$ that acts multiplicatively with respect to the tensor product. Our scheme also employs a representation of classical observables ($L^\infty$ functions of the state) by quantum observables (self-adjoint operators) acting on the Fock space, and a representation of probability densities in $L^1$ by quantum states. Combining these constructions leads to an approximation of the Koopman evolution of observables that is representable as evaluation of a tree tensor network built on a tensor product subspace $\mathcal H_τ^{\otimes n} \subset F(\mathcal H_τ)$ of arbitrarily high grading $n \in \mathbb N$. A key feature of this quantum-inspired approximation is that it captures information from a tensor product space of dimension $(2d+1)^n$, generated from a collection of $2d + 1$ eigenfunctions of $W_τ$. Furthermore, the approximation is positivity preserving. The paper contains a theoretical convergence analysis of the method and numerical applications to two dynamical systems on the 2-torus: an ergodic torus rotation as an example with pure point Koopman spectrum and a Stepanoff flow as an example with topological weak mixing.

摘要翻译

对称质量生成（symmetric mass generation）是在没有自发对称破缺的情况下，由相互作用诱导打开的费米子能隙。Wang和Wen的无反常3-4-5-0模型为该现象提供了一个最小的一维设定，但直接的格点实现面临两个障碍：局域手性离散化中的费米子加倍问题，以及六费米子隙间相互作用的微扰不可相关性。我们解决了这两个障碍。首先，我们在严格一维的切向费米子格点（tangent-fermion lattice）上表述该模型，其中非局域跳跃产生单一手性分支而无镜像伙伴，同时保持高效的张量网络表示。其次，我们添加一个Hubbard型密度-密度相互作用（Luttinger参数$K$），将3-4-5-0相互作用的标度维数从$5$降至$5K$，使其在$K<2/5$时成为相关项。密度矩阵重正化群计算表明，在该区域内激发能隙打开，且不出现简并基态，这正是对称质量生成的特征标志。

Abstract

Symmetric mass generation is the interaction-induced opening of a fermion gap without spontaneous symmetry breaking. The anomaly-free 3-4-5-0 model of Wang and Wen provides a minimal one-dimensional setting for this phenomenon, but a direct lattice realization faces two obstacles: fermion doubling for local chiral discretizations and perturbative irrelevance of the six-fermion gapping interaction. We address both obstacles. First, we formulate the model on a strictly one-dimensional tangent-fermion lattice, where a nonlocal hopping produces a single chiral branch without a mirror partner while retaining an efficient tensor-network representation. Second, we add a Hubbard-type density-density interaction (Luttinger parameter $K$) that reduces the scaling dimension of the 3-4-5-0 interaction from $5$ to $5K$, making it relevant for $K<2/5$. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations show the opening of an excitation gap in this regime without the appearance of a degenerate ground state, the hallmark of symmetric mass generation.

TL;DR: This paper benchmarks zero-setup GPU-accelerated quantum circuit simulators using MPS and Pauli path methods, demonstrating that GPUs provide large speedups (e.g., ~1700x for Pauli path on IBM's 127-qubit kicked Ising model) and enable accuracy levels not reachable with CPU-only implementations.
摘要翻译

实践者越来越依赖托管的模拟环境，但其性能特征仍缺乏系统记录。我们对两种广泛使用的方法——矩阵乘积态（MPS）和泡利路径模拟（PPS）——进行了GPU加速近似量子模拟的系统性基准测试，将BlueQubit（一种托管工具，负责硬件配置、模拟器设置和作业编排）与AWS Braket、Quantum Rings、Qiskit pauli-prop以及用Julia编写的PauliPropagation进行了比较。对于MPS，我们发现GPU运行时间随键维度呈次二次方扩展，且随着规模增大，相比CPU的优势日益明显。针对IBM 127量子比特 kicked Ising 基准上的泡利路径模拟，GPU在精细截断阈值（$\delta = 2.5 \times 10^{-5}$，2760万个泡利项）下实现了高达约$1{,}700\times$的加速，并且是唯一能达到$\delta < 10^{-5}$以下精度范围的后端，而这在此处评估的基于商用CPU的实现和自包含SDK中是无法实现的。我们还对这些模拟器在不同场景下的表现提供了可复现的特征描述，包括单独评估所无法展示的权衡。所有基准测试代码和配置均公开在GitHub仓库中。

Abstract

Practitioners increasingly rely on hosted simulation environments, but their performance characteristics remain poorly documented. We present a systematic benchmarking study of GPU-accelerated approximate quantum simulation across two widely used methods: matrix product states (MPS) and Pauli path simulation (PPS), comparing BlueQubit (a hosted tool that handles hardware provisioning, simulator configuration, and job orchestration) against AWS Braket, Quantum Rings, Qiskit pauli-prop, and PauliPropagation (written in Julia). For MPS, we find that GPU runtime yields sub-quadratic scaling with bond dimension, with a growing advantage over CPU at increasing scale. For Pauli path simulation on IBM's 127-qubit kicked Ising benchmark, GPUs deliver up to ${\sim}1{,}700\times$ speedup at fine truncation thresholds ($δ= 2.5 \times 10^{-5}$, 27.6M Pauli terms), and are the only backends that reach accuracy regimes below $δ= 10^{-5}$, which remained inaccessible to the commodity CPU-based implementations and self-contained SDKs evaluated here. We also provide a reproducible characterization of these simulators across regimes, including tradeoffs that isolated evaluations do not show. All benchmarking code and configurations are in a public GitHub repository.

摘要翻译

利用变分量子特征求解器（VQE）研究相互作用玻色子模型（IBM）的球形至形变量子相变。我们研究了具有 \( \chi=-\sqrt{7}/2 \) 的 \( U(5) \)–\( SU(3) \) 过渡哈密顿量。针对集体核模型，我们发展了一种保持对称性、最小量子比特的 VQE 框架，在不损害有限尺寸量子相变物理的前提下，大幅降低了量子比特需求。该相变通过归一化的 \( d \) 玻色子占据数和基态能量导数来表征。发现有限尺寸结果趋近于解析临界点 \( \xi_c=8/17\simeq0.470588 \)，独立的序参量外推得到 \( \xi_\infty=0.46986(61) \)。VQE 以数值精度再现了基态能量和结构可观测量。这些结果证明了对称性约化的 VQE 在集体核动力学和量子相变的高效量子模拟中的潜力。

Abstract

The spherical-to-deformed quantum phase transition of the Interacting Boson Model (IBM) is investigated using the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE). The $U(5)$--$SU(3)$ transitional Hamiltonian is studied with $χ=-\sqrt{7}/2$. We develop a symmetry-preserving, minimum-qubit VQE framework for collective nuclear models, achieving a substantial reduction in qubit requirements without compromising the finite-size quantum-phase-transition physics. The transition is characterized through the normalized $d$-boson occupation and ground-state energy derivatives. Finite-size results are found to approach the analytic critical point $ξ_c=8/17\simeq0.470588$, with an independent order-parameter extrapolation yielding $ξ_\infty=0.46986(61)$. These results demonstrate the potential of symmetry-reduced VQE for efficient quantum simulations of collective nuclear dynamics and quantum phase transitions.

摘要翻译

我们通过分析黑洞事件视界附近由三体GHZ态和W类态导出的二体混合态，研究了强引力场下量子隐形传态（quantum teleportation）的鲁棒性。考虑两个观察者分别接近Schwarzschild黑洞或Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GHS) 伸缩子黑洞的事件视界，而第三个观察者留在平直空间中。在求迹掉其中一个子系统后，我们量化了所得二体信道的隐形传态保真度。通过Dirac场的量子化和Bogoliubov变换，我们计算了霍金辐射和时空曲率影响下的传态保真度。结果表明，尽管纠缠发生退化，由W类态导出的信道其保真度仍高于经典阈值\(f>\frac{2}{3}\)，而由GHZ态导出的信道则无法达到。这表明，只要初始纠缠态保留可用的二体纠缠，量子隐形传态在黑洞附近仍然是可行的。

Abstract

We investigate the robustness of quantum teleportation in the presence of strong gravitational fields by analysing bipartite mixed states derived from tripartite GHZ and W-class states near black hole event horizons. Considering a scenario where two observers approach the horizon of either a Schwarzschild or a Garfinkle Horowitz Strominger (GHS) Dilaton black hole while a third remains in flat space, we quantify the teleportation fidelity of the resulting bipartite channels after tracing out one party. Through the quantization of Dirac fields and Bogoliubov transformations, we compute the teleportation fidelity under the influence of Hawking radiation and spacetime curvature. Our results show that while entanglement degrades, teleportation fidelity remains above the classical threshold of $f>\frac{2}{3}$ for channels derived from W-class states, but not for GHZ-derived states. This indicates that quantum teleportation can remain feasible near black holes provided the initial entangled state retains useful bipartite entanglement.

摘要翻译

量子热晶体管已在三量子比特系统的背景下被广泛研究，其中每个量子比特分别与一个马尔可夫谐振子浴相互作用。马尔可夫性（Markovianity）是对系统施加的一种假设，即环境在很短时间内失去其记忆；而非马尔可夫性（non-Markovianity）则是一个普遍特征，天然存在于大量现实场景中。这里我们不采用马尔可夫环境，而是提出一种晶体管，其中工作物质与由无限长qutrit链构成的环境之间的相互作用基于周期性碰撞。我们将该装置称为工作物质热晶体管，因为该模型聚焦于流入和流出工作物质中每个独立量子比特、往返于系统与环境不同部分之间的热流。我们发现晶体管效应在该装置中依然存在，并描绘了热流放大如何依赖于调制环境的温度、系统-环境耦合强度以及相互作用时间。我们进一步表明，即使其中一个非调制的环境与系统断开连接，放大效应仍然非零。此外，由于环境由三能级系统构成，我们能够考虑qutrit能级间距中的微弱扰动所带来的影响，这会导致环境中出现非线性。我们考虑的非线性分别为transmon型或Kerr型。我们发现，对于环境中transmon型和Kerr型非线性，均存在参数范围可实现显著放大。最后，我们通过观察放大随时间的非单调行为来检测系统中诱导出的非马尔可夫性，并使用基于可区分性的非马尔可夫性度量对其进行量化。

Abstract

Quantum thermal transistors have been widely studied in the context of three-qubit systems, where each qubit interacts separately with a Markovian harmonic bath. Markovianity is an assumption that is imposed on a system if the environment loses its memory within short while, while non-Markovianity is a general feature, inherently present in a large fraction of realistic scenarios. Instead of Markovian environments, here we propose a transistor in which the interaction between the working substance and an environment comprising of an infinite chain of qutrits is based on periodic collisions. We refer to the device as a working-substance thermal transistor, since the model focuses on heat currents flowing in and out of each individual qubit of the working substance to and from different parts of the system and environment. We find that the transistor effect prevails in this apparatus and we depict how the amplification of heat currents depends on the temperature of the modulating environment, the system-environment coupling strength and the interaction time. We further show that there exists a non-zero amplification even if one of the environments, that is not the modulating one, is detached from the system. Additionally, the environment, being comprised of three-level systems, allows us to consider the effects of frail perturbations in the energy-spacings of the qutrit, leading to a non-linearity in the environment. We consider non-linearities that are either of transmon- or of Kerr-type. We find parameter ranges where there is a significant amplification for both transmon- and Kerr-type non-linearities in the environment. Finally, we detect the non-Markovianity induced in the system from a non-monotonic behavior of the amplification observed with respect to time, and quantify it using the distinguishability-based measure of non-Markovianity.

摘要翻译

量子游走为探测从生物网络到合成材料的复杂系统的结构和动力学性质提供了通用框架。然而，它们在当前含噪预容错量子计算机上的实现受到退相干的根本性限制。图结构的传统稠密编码需要过深的电路，使其与现有硬件不兼容。在此，我们引入一种算法，利用对称性扇区编码，以增加量子比特数量为代价来降低电路深度，同时集成尊重对称性的后选择作为有效的噪声缓解策略。这种组合使我们能够在实际量子硬件上执行针对生物网络基序的实用量子游走电路。我们将所提出的方法与已知的最先进电路架构进行基准比较，突出我们的方法在适度量子比特开销下显著降低电路深度。利用40个量子比特，我们在包含多达17个节点和20条边的复杂图上实现量子游走——这是迄今在超导硬件上最大的实验，7步中的Hellinger保真度超过87%。我们展示了一项原理验证案例研究，说明如何将实验获得的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络上的量子游走动力学应用于疾病相关基因的优先级排序。我们讨论了该框架在预容错时代的可扩展性及其研究更大生物网络的潜力。

Abstract

Quantum walks provide a versatile framework for probing the structural and dynamical properties of complex systems ranging from biological networks to synthetic materials. However, their realization on current noisy pre-fault-tolerant quantum computers is fundamentally limited by decoherence. Conventional dense encodings of graph structures require prohibitively deep circuits, making them incompatible with existing hardware. Here we introduce an algorithm that leverages symmetry-sector encoding and trades circuit depth for the number of qubits, while integrating symmetry-respecting postselection as an effective noise-mitigation strategy. This combination enables us to execute practical quantum-walk circuits for biological network motifs on actual quantum hardware. We benchmark the proposed methodology against known state-of-the-art circuit architectures, highlighting significant reduction of circuit depth in our approach at the cost of moderate qubit overhead. Utilizing 40 qubits, we implement quantum walks on complex graphs containing up to 17 nodes and 20 edges -- the largest experiment on superconducting hardware to date, with the Hellinger fidelity exceeding 87% throughout 7 steps. We present a proof-of-principle case study that illustrates how experimentally obtained quantum-walk dynamics on a protein-protein-interaction network can be applied to prioritizing disease-associated genes. We discuss the framework scalability in the pre-fault-tolerant era and its potential for studying larger biological networks.

摘要翻译

量子存储器中由退相干引起的纠缠退化是可扩展量子网络面临的关键挑战。我们提出了一种基于[[4,2,2]]量子检错码的纠缠蒸馏协议，推导了其输出保真度与产率的解析表达式，并将其与BBPSSW协议进行基准对比。除单轮性能外，我们还通过多轮保真度与累积产率分析进一步考察了两种协议的迭代行为。随后，我们研究了一种存储阶段的恢复策略，即在不解码和重编码的情况下，对所保留的逻辑纠缠态重复执行基于稳定子的综合征检测，从而避免从头再生和重新分发纠缠。我们的分析表明，当经典通信延迟足够小时，该策略可将可用存储寿命延长至超过BBPSSW基线。我们推导了延迟阈值，并量化了不同综合征检测次数下的累积接受概率。敏感性分析进一步表明，局部门操作与测量误差会缩小保真度优势区域及可容许的通信延迟窗口，凸显了足够精确的局域操作的重要性。这些结果为在有限通信延迟和非理想局域操作条件下评估逻辑态保留的存储阶段效益提供了定量框架。

Abstract

The degradation of entanglement in quantum memories due to decoherence is a critical challenge for scalable quantum networks. We present an entanglement distillation protocol based on the [[4,2,2]] quantum error-detecting code, deriving analytical expressions for its output fidelity and yield, and benchmarking it against the BBPSSW protocol. In addition to single round performance, we further examine the iterative behavior of both protocols through multi-round fidelity and cumulative yield analysis. We then investigate a storage-stage recovery strategy in which the retained logical entangled state is subjected to repeated stabilizer-based syndrome checks without decoding and re-encoding, avoiding the need to regenerate and redistribute entanglement from scratch. Our analysis shows that this strategy can extend the usable storage lifetime beyond the BBPSSW baseline when the classical communication latency is sufficiently small. We derive latency thresholds and quantify the cumulative acceptance probabilities for different numbers of syndrome checks. A sensitivity analysis further shows that local gate and measurement errors reduce the fidelity advantage region and the admissible communication latency window, highlighting the importance of sufficiently accurate local operations. These results provide a quantitative framework for assessing the storage-stage benefit of logical state retention in the presence of finite communication latency and nonideal local operations.

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种物理信息神经模糊框架，通过Bhattacharyya Veto和CPTP收缩约束在IBM 156比特处理器上实现了89.5%准确率的量子错误归因，能够有效区分软件错误与硬件噪声并防止错误缓解技术被误用。
摘要翻译

随着量子处理器规模扩展至超过100量子比特，区分软件缺陷与随机硬件噪声成为一项关键的诊断挑战。我们提出了一种神经模糊框架，通过将自适应神经模糊推理系统（ANFIS）与基于物理的特征工程相结合，来解决这一归因问题。我们引入了巴塔查里亚否决（Bhattacharyya Veto），这是一个基于设备经验表征的弱噪声底的硬物理约束，利用CPTP压缩性保证单侧可靠性，防止分类器将拓扑上不可能的输出去布归因于噪声。该框架在IBM的156量子比特Heron r2处理器（ibm_fez）上进行了验证，覆盖了17个算法家族的105个电路，实现了89.5%的有效准确率（±5.9%置信区间）。该系统实现了安全失效模式，将14.3%的模糊案例标记为人工审查，而非强制进行低置信度预测。我们解决了关键模糊性——例如区分正确的Grover放大与缺陷引起的坍缩——并识别了单基诊断的基本限制，包括Z基盲区，其中相位翻转错误在统计上保持不可见。这项工作建立了一个稳健、可解释的诊断层，防止纠错技术被应用于逻辑上有缺陷的电路。

Abstract

As quantum processors scale beyond 100 qubits, distinguishing software bugs from stochastic hardware noise becomes a critical diagnostic challenge. We present a neuro-fuzzy framework that addresses this attribution problem by combining Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) with physics-grounded feature engineering. We introduce the Bhattacharyya Veto, a hard physical constraint grounded in the empirically characterized weak-noise floor of the device, with CPTP contraction guaranteeing one-sided soundness that prevents the classifier from attributing topologically impossible output distributions to noise. Validated on IBM's 156-qubit Heron r2 processor (ibm_fez) across 105 circuits spanning 17 algorithm families, the framework achieves 89.5% effective accuracy (+/- 5.9% CI). The system implements a safe failure mode, flagging 14.3% of ambiguous cases for manual review rather than forcing low-confidence predictions. We resolve key ambiguities - such as distinguishing correct Grover amplification from bug-induced collapse - and identify fundamental limits of single-basis diagnostics, including a Z-basis blind spot where phase-flip errors remain statistically invisible. This work establishes a robust, interpretable diagnostic layer that prevents error mitigation techniques from being applied to logically flawed circuits.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于辅助比特寄存器和投票协议的单向量子计算实时测量误差缓解方法，能够在计算过程中实时检测并减少单比特测量误差，并通过模拟和IBM量子硬件实验证明了其有效性。
摘要翻译

我们提出了一种针对单量子比特测量误差的量子误差缓解方案，特别适用于单向量子计算。与已建立的、需要多次运行电路的基于电路的量子计算误差缓解方法不同，我们的方法能够在单向计算的测量处理过程中实时缓解测量误差。为此，一个辅助量子比特寄存器与待测量量子比特纠缠，并在随后进行额外测量。通过在所有测量结果上采用投票协议，可以在单向计算继续的同时实时缓解发生的测量误差。我们给出了一个解析表达式，用于根据误差率和辅助量子比特数量计算检测到测量误差的概率。由此，我们推导出在给定测量误差率和所需检测测量误差的成功概率下，辅助寄存器规模的估计。此外，我们还在我们的缓解方法中考虑了CNOT门误差，并研究了这如何影响检测测量误差的概率。最后，我们在原理验证模拟中以及在IBM量子硬件上执行的实验中表明，我们的方法能够仅使用少量辅助量子比特即可显著减少单向量子计算中的测量误差。

Abstract

We propose a quantum error mitigation scheme for single-qubit measurement errors, particularly suited for one-way quantum computation. Contrary to well established error mitigation methods for circuit-based quantum computation that require the circuits to be run several times, our method is capable of mitigating measurement errors in real-time, during the processing measurements of the one-way computation. For that, an ancillary qubit register is entangled with the to-be-measured qubit and additionally measured afterwards. By using a voting protocol on all measurement outcomes, occurring measurement errors can be mitigated in real-time while the one-way computation continues. We provide an analytical expression for the probability to detect a measurement error depending on the error rate and the number of ancilla qubits. From this, we derive an estimate of the ancilla register size for a given measurement error rate and a required success probability to detect a measurement error. Additionally, we also consider the CNOT gate error in our mitigation method and investigate how this influences the probability to detect a measurement error. Finally, we show in proof-of-principle simulations and in experiments executed on IBM quantum hardware that our method is capable of reducing the measurement errors significantly in a one-way quantum computation with only a small number of ancilla qubits.
