TL;DR: 本文通过将不同奥托引擎的功率分解为公共特征功和实现特有的特征时间，比较了四种实现的功率，发现最大速度受热浴热化时间之和限制，并根据驱动与热化是否同时进行区分出平方和线性两种标度行为。
摘要翻译

一般热机具有不同的时间或能量尺度：温度、与热浴的耦合、内部自由动力学与相互作用，以及外部驱动。我们探讨的问题是：哪些参数决定给定热机的速度，以及如何利用这些参数可靠地比较不同类型的热机？具体而言，我们考虑奥托热机的四种实现方式，每种都以相同的奥托效率运行，并旨在表征和比较它们的功率输出。本文的主要见解是，无论其动力学实现多么不同，每台热机的功率都可以分解为一个共同的特征功和一个特定实现的特征时间。特征功仅取决于机器的内部频率和温度，而特征时间取决于与热浴的耦合强度以及特定实现的驱动方式。这一观察使我们能够通过特征时间来比较不同热机的功率，从而将相关参数空间缩减为捕捉热机性能动力学方面的参数。尽管动力学实现不同，该框架仍揭示了简单的共同特征。在所有情况下，最大运行速度受限于一个共同的时标，即热浴与冷浴特征热化时间之和。此外，这四种热机分为两个不同的渐近类别：驱动与热化同时进行的实现表现出二次标度，而功提取与热化交替进行的实现表现出线性标度。这些结果揭示了决定量子奥托热机运行速度的一般动力学特征。

Abstract

A general thermal machine is characterized by distinct time or energy scales: temperature, coupling to the heat baths, internal free dynamics and interactions, and external driving. We address the question: what parameters determine the speed of a given engine, and how can they be used to reliably compare different types of engine? Specifically, we consider four realizations of the Otto engine, each operating with the same Otto efficiency, and aim to characterize and compare their power outputs. The main insight of this paper is that, irrespective of their very different dynamical implementations, the power of each engine can be factorized into a common characteristic work and an implementation-specific characteristic time. The characteristic work depends only on the internal frequencies of the machine and the temperatures, whereas the characteristic time depends on the coupling strength to the baths and on the implementation-specific driving. This observation allows us to compare the power of different engines through their characteristic times and thereby reduce the relevant parameter space to parameters that capture the dynamical aspects of engine performance. Despite different dynamical implementations, this framework reveals simple common features. In all cases, the maximum operating speed is limited by a common timescale given by the sum of the characteristic thermalization times of the hot and cold baths. Moreover, the four engines fall into two distinct asymptotic classes: implementations in which driving and thermalization occur simultaneously exhibit quadratic scaling, whereas those in which work extraction and thermalization alternate exhibit linear scaling. These results expose general dynamical features that determine the operational speed of quantum Otto engines.

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于量子绝热理论导出的绝热切向调制（ATM）脉冲，用于单次量子比特频率跟踪，在接近灵敏度极限的同时实现了较宽的失谐范围和对幅度波动的强鲁棒性。
摘要翻译

理解和抑制二能级量子系统中的噪声，是实现高保真度量子比特控制的关键。传统的频率跟踪技术（如拉姆齐干涉测量法）在基本原理上受到灵敏度、带宽和动态范围之间权衡关系的限制。本文提出了一种绝热切向调制（ATM）脉冲，该脉冲源于量子绝热理论，能将量子比特失谐映射为S形、接近二值化的响应。通过解析建模辅助的数值模拟，我们证明脉冲灵敏度和失谐范围可通过简单的设计参数独立调节。我们推导了控制这些量的标度关系，并验证了其与模拟结果的一致性。单次ATM测量即可达到与多次拉姆齐平均相当的灵敏度，从而能以更低的闭环白噪声基底跟踪频率显著更高的噪声分量。此外，与基于Shinnar-Le Roux形式体系推导的二值响应脉冲相比，该脉冲对振幅涨落表现出很强的鲁棒性。综合以上特性，ATM脉冲为鲁棒的量子比特频率跟踪提供了一种有前景的方法。

Abstract

Understanding and mitigating noise in two-level quantum systems is essential for achieving high-fidelity qubit control. Conventional frequency tracking techniques, such as Ramsey interferometry, are fundamentally limited by trade-offs between sensitivity, bandwidth, and dynamic range. Here we introduce the adiabatic tangentially-modulated (ATM) pulse, a pulse derived from quantum adiabatic theory that maps qubit detuning onto a sigmoidal, near-binary response. Using numerical simulations supported by analytical modeling, we show that pulse sensitivity and detuning range can be independently engineered through simple design parameters. We derive scaling relations governing these quantities and demonstrate their agreement with simulation. A single-shot ATM measurement achieves sensitivity comparable to that obtained from multi-shot Ramsey averaging, enabling tracking of substantially higher frequency noise components with a lower closed-loop white-noise floor. In addition, this pulse exhibits strong robustness to amplitude fluctuations compared with binary response pulses derived from the Shinnar-Le Roux formalism. Together, these properties establish the ATM pulse as a promising approach for robust qubit frequency tracking.

TL;DR: 本文通过将最优恢复通道优化转化为互补通道上的商酉群优化，并给出满足正交性KL条件的码的解析恢复形式及更紧的纠缠保真度下界，避免了在大规模Kraus算子空间中的直接搜索。
摘要翻译

近似量子纠错(AQEC)将离散变量和连续变量量子纠错的框架扩展至Knill-Laflamme(KL)条件之外，其中恢复性能通过纠缠保真度来量化。近期研究已能够利用转置信道恢复实现对近最优纠缠保真度的高效评估。然而，对于超出KL条件的一般码，确定全局最优恢复映射及其纠缠保真度仍是一项重大的计算挑战。随着噪声Kraus算子的数量随系统规模快速增长，直接优化变得不可行，且现有方法缺乏将该优化严格约化至可处理维度的理论保证。本文推导了互补信道最优环境态的显式刻画，将恢复信道上的优化转化为商酉算子上的等价优化。对于仅满足KL条件正交性部分的更广泛码类，我们证明了最优恢复映射具有显式解析形式。基于该形式，我们推导了新的严格纠缠保真度下界，该下界严格优于转置恢复界。我们进一步发展了一种基于主分量的新型恢复策略，并推导了噪声截断所引入误差的严格界。我们的方法能够高效搜索AQEC码的近似恢复映射，避免了在全Kraus算子空间上进行优化的需要。

Abstract

Approximate quantum error correction (AQEC) extends the framework of discrete- and continuous-variable quantum error correction beyond the Knill-Laflamme (KL) conditions, where the recovery performance is quantified by entanglement fidelity. Recent studies have enabled efficient evaluation of near-optimal entanglement fidelity using transpose-channel recovery. Yet, determining the global optimal recovery map and its entanglement fidelity for general codes beyond the KL conditions remains a major computational challenge. Direct optimization becomes prohibitive as the number of noise Kraus operators grows rapidly with system size, and existing approaches lack rigorous guarantees for reducing this optimization to a tractable dimension. Here, we derive an explicit characterization of the optimal environmental state of complement channel, which transforms the optimization over recovery channels into an equivalent optimization over quotient unitaries. For a broader class of codes that satisfy only the orthogonality part of the KL conditions, we show that the optimal recovery map admits an explicit analytical form. Building on this form, we derive novel rigorous lower bounds of entanglement fidelity that strictly improve upon the transpose-recovery bound. We further develop a novel recovery strategy based on principle components, and derive a rigorous bound on the error introduced by noise truncation. Our approach enables efficient searches for approximate recovery maps for AQEC codes, avoiding the need to optimize over the full Kraus-operator space.

摘要翻译

非定域实在论是与量子理论相冲突的最后一个经典基石，并已被证实在双粒子体系中很大程度上站不住脚[Nature 446, 871 (2007); Nature Physics 4, 681 (2008)]。我们将Leggett型非定域实在模型推广到任意N体系统并考虑偏振器设置，导出了能区分量子预言与非定域实在论的严格不等式。推导过程得到一个具有普适有效性的基本双重不等式，在特定测量设置下可由此得出Leggett型界限。作为示例，我们展示了Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger（GHZ）态对这些不等式的量子违背，最大违背值为2(√5+1)。我们的结果表明，多体系统中的非定域实在论是可实验检验的。

Abstract

Nonlocal realism represents the last classical cornerstone in conflict with quantum theory, and has been shown to be largely untenable in bipartite systems [Nature 446, 871 (2007); Nature Physics 4, 681 (2008)]. We extend the Leggett-type nonlocal realistic model to arbitrary N-partite systems with polarizer settings, and derive rigorous inequalities that distinguish quantum predictions from nonlocal realistic theories. The derivation yields a fundamental double inequality that is universally valid, from which the Leggett-type bounds follow under specific measurement settings. As an illustration, we demonstrate quantum violations of these inequalities for Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states, with maximal violation 2(\sqrt{5}+1). Our results show that nonlocal realism in multipartite systems is experimentally testable.

摘要翻译

我们提出一种基于腔-磁振子（cavity-magnon）系统的瞬态矢量量子磁力测量方案。通过利用从库工程（reservoir-engineered）压缩稳态初始化的有限时间动力学，我们的方案保留了由压缩引起的残余正交分量噪声抑制，从而抑制瞬态附加噪声，并将短时信噪比提升至超越传统非压缩稳态极限的水平。对腔输出场的正交分量进行IQ解调，可以无串扰地重构瞬态磁场的全部分量，从而同时获取其大小与方向。这一矢量能力适用于短寿命磁性现象，如脉冲自旋激发、磁性织构、纳米尺度电流瞬态及生物磁信号。在长时间极限下，我们推导出闭合形式的稳态噪声谱，并确定了共振噪声消除条件 \(g_{am}=\sqrt{\kappa_a\kappa_m}/2\)，在该条件下，无需强相干耦合即可使腔附加噪声消失。注入压缩态还可进一步抑制远离共振时的腔附加噪声，而由 \(N\) 个钇铁石榴石（yttrium iron garnet）球组成的阵列可将磁振子探针噪声贡献降低至 \(1/N\)。我们的结果确立了腔-磁子系统作为瞬态、矢量分辨量子磁力测量的可扩展平台。

Abstract

We propose a transient vector quantum magnetometry protocol based on cavity-magnon systems. By exploiting finite-time dynamics initialized from a reservoir-engineered squeezed steady state, our scheme retains residual squeezing-induced quadrature noise reduction, which suppresses transient added noise and enhances the short-time signal-to-noise ratio beyond conventional unsqueezed steady-state limits. IQ demodulation of orthogonal cavity-output quadratures enables crosstalk-free reconstruction of all three components of a transient magnetic field, providing access to both its magnitude and orientation. This vector capability is relevant for short-lived magnetic phenomena such as pulsed spin excitations, magnetic textures, nanoscale current transients, and biomagnetic signals. In the long-time limit, we derive a closed-form stationary noise spectrum and identify the on-resonance noise-cancellation condition $g_{am}=\sqrt{κ_aκ_m}/2$ at which the cavity-added noise vanishes without strong coherent coupling. Injected squeezing further suppresses the cavity-added noise away from resonance, while an array of $N$ yttrium iron garnet spheres reduces the magnon-probe noise contribution by a factor of $1/N$. Our results establish cavity-magnon systems as a scalable platform for transient, vector-resolved quantum magnetometry.

摘要翻译

早期容错量子计算机预计能够支持可靠但深度受限的量子电路，同时经典计算资源仍然可用。这些条件推动了混合相干算法的发展，这些算法将量子模拟作为核心算法原语。这一趋势要求量子模拟方法能够以浅电路运行，并在门复杂度标度上允许系统性的改进。在此，我们引入了qSHIFT，一种用于模拟哈密顿量$H=\sum_{i=1}^{L}h_iH_i$的自适应采样协议。qSHIFT实现了门复杂度$\mathcal{O}_r\left((\lambda t)^{1+1/r}/\varepsilon^{1/r}\right)$，其中$r$是一个算法参数，$\lambda=\sum_i |h_i|$，$\varepsilon$表示目标精度。相对于qDRIFT，对于给定的目标精度，增加$r$能系统性地改善门复杂度，而无需额外的量子成本。与Trotter化不同，采样门的数量名义上与$L$无关。qSHIFT保留了qDRIFT的基本门集，并且与qSWIFT不同，它既不需要辅助量子比特，也不需要受控操作。这种改进的门复杂度标度是以在每轮自适应采样中进行涉及$L^r$个系数的经典计算为代价的。

Abstract

Early fault-tolerant quantum computers are expected to support reliable but depth-limited quantum circuits, while classical computational resources remain available. These conditions have motivated hybrid coherent algorithms which use quantum simulation as a central algorithmic primitive. This trend calls for quantum-simulation methods that operate with shallow circuits and admit systematic improvements in gate-complexity scaling. Here, we introduce qSHIFT, an adaptive sampling protocol for simulating a Hamiltonian $H=\sum_{i=1}^{L}h_iH_i$. qSHIFT achieves gate complexity $\mathcal{O}_r\left((λt)^{1+1/r}/\varepsilon^{1/r}\right)$, where $r$ is an algorithmic parameter, $λ=\sum_i |h_i|$ and $\varepsilon$ denotes the target precision. Relative to qDRIFT, increasing $r$ systematically improves the gate complexity for a given target precision without incurring extra quantum cost. Unlike Trotterization, the number of sampled gates is nominally independent of $L$. qSHIFT retains the elementary gate set of qDRIFT and, unlike qSWIFT, requires neither ancillary qubits nor controlled operations. The improved gate complexity scaling is obtained at the cost of a classical calculation involving $L^r$ coefficients at each adaptive sampling round.

摘要翻译

量子去噪扩散模型近期已成为生成式量子机器学习中一个强大的框架。在本工作中，我们通过引入一种条件机制来扩展这些模型，该机制能够生成从多个目标分布中采样的量子态。通过在不同类别的量子态之间共享参数，我们的方法避免了为每个分布单独训练模型的需求。我们通过涵盖单量子比特生成任务、纠缠态制备以及多体基态生成的数值模拟来验证我们的方法。在这些任务中，条件机制显著将目标态生成的误差降低了超过一个数量级。最后，我们进行了一项消融研究，以量化关键超参数对模型性能的影响。

Abstract

Quantum denoising diffusion models have recently emerged as a powerful framework for generative quantum machine learning. In this work, we extend these models by introducing a conditioning mechanism that enables the generation of quantum states drawn from multiple target distributions. By sharing parameters across distinct classes of quantum states, our approach avoids the need to train separate models for each distribution. We validate our method through numerical simulations that span single-qubit generation tasks, entangled state preparation, and many-body ground state generation. Across these tasks, conditioning significantly reduced the error of targeted state generation by more than an order of magnitude. Finally, we perform an ablation study to quantify the effect of key hyperparameters on the model performance.

摘要翻译

我们研究了环境诱导退相干对物质波塔尔干涉的抑制。系统被建模为被周期性光栅衍射的原子束，其横向动力学在近轴近似下描述。环境耦合通过一个有效的开放系统模型引入，该模型对衍射分量之间的空间相干性进行指数阻尼，从而能够在相干的塔尔区间与非相干的远场衍射极限之间进行连续插值。除了通常的强度和横向动量分布外，我们还分析了与衍射物质波相关的局域概率流。相应的玻姆（Bohmian）或流体动力学表示在此被用作一种诊断工具，它完全等价于标准量子描述，且除了近轴波场的概率流外，不引入任何额外假设。在当前的塔尔几何结构中，该分析展示了退相干如何逐步抑制“地毯”结构并平滑横向动量分布，而流动仍可能保持为由光栅周期性决定的通道组织。这些结果说明，在周期性物质波塔尔几何中，可见干涉的消失与光栅定义的流动域组织的退化不必同时发生。特别地，在多缝干涉特征已被强烈抑制的参数区域内，通量通道结构仍可存续。这一区别为物质波塔尔干涉测量中的退相干提供了局域表征，并补充了先前在更简单干涉和受限几何中基于轨迹的相干性损失分析。

Abstract

We investigate the suppression of matter-wave Talbot interference under environmentally induced decoherence. The system is modeled as an atomic beam diffracted by a periodic grating whose transverse dynamics is described within the paraxial approximation. Environmental coupling is introduced through an effective open-system model that exponentially damps spatial coherences between diffracted components, allowing a continuous interpolation between the coherent Talbot regime and the incoherent far-field diffraction limit. In addition to the usual intensity and transverse-momentum distributions, we analyze the local probability flow associated with the diffracted matter wave. The corresponding Bohmian, or hydrodynamic, representation is used here as a diagnostic tool fully equivalent to the standard quantum description, with no additional assumptions beyond the probability current of the paraxial wave field. In the present Talbot geometry, this analysis shows how decoherence progressively suppresses the carpet structure and smooths the transverse-momentum distribution, while the flow may remain organized into channels determined by the grating periodicity. The results illustrate, in a periodic matter-wave Talbot geometry, that the loss of visible interference and the degradation of the grating-defined flow-domain organization need not occur simultaneously. In particular, flux-channel structures can persist in parameter regimes where multislit interference features have already been strongly reduced. This distinction provides a local characterization of decoherence in matter-wave Talbot interferometry and complements previous trajectory-based analyses of coherence loss in simpler interference and confined geometries.

TL;DR: This paper proves that for qubit-mapped fermion models with single-site Coulomb interactions, the Hamiltonian algebra dimension grows exponentially with system size, and thus Cartan-based fast-forwarding cannot efficiently simulate these models.
摘要翻译

我们研究了量子比特映射相互作用费米子模型的哈密顿代数及其可快速前向性。我们证明了具有单位点库仑相互作用的费米子模型的哈密顿代数维数受限于位点数的指数函数的下界，并且基于Cartan的快速前向方法对该类模型的电路深度也展现出相同的标度。我们将此命题应用于安德森杂质模型和哈伯德模型，并证明这些模型的哈密顿代数维数随位点数呈指数增长。哈密顿代数的这些行为意味着，在将马约拉纳算子映射为单项泡利串的费米子-量子比特映射下，由这些费米子模型获得的量子比特模型无法使用基于Cartan的快速前向方法进行高效模拟。

Abstract

We study the Hamiltonian algebra of qubit-mapped interacting fermion models and their fast-forwardability. We prove that the dimension of the Hamiltonian algebra of the fermion model with single-site Coulomb interaction is bounded from below by the exponential function of the number of sites, and the circuit depth of the Cartan-based fast-forwarding method for such a model also exhibits the same scaling. We apply this proposition to the Anderson impurity model and the Hubbard model and show that the dimension of the Hamiltonian algebra of these models scales exponentially with the number of sites. These behaviors of the Hamiltonian algebras imply that, under fermion-qubit mappings that map Majorana operators to single-term Pauli strings, the qubit models obtained from these fermion models cannot be efficiently simulated using the Cartan-based fast-forwarding method.

TL;DR: This paper introduces structured hard sampling circuits encoded in spacetime quantum codes, achieving simultaneous hardware noise suppression and experiment fidelity certification, demonstrated on a 64-qubit depth-73 Clifford circuit with 314 T gates and a lower bound fidelity of 0.349 at 95% confidence.
摘要翻译

基于采样的方案是展示超越经典超级计算机能力的量子计算的重要候选。然而，要将它们的复杂度理论困难性与可扩展量子计算普遍所需的两种能力——抑制硬件错误和验证量子计算本身——结合起来一直十分困难。在此，我们通过引入结构化电路来同时解决这两个问题，这些电路除具有可证明的困难性保证外，还允许编码到量子码中。这使我们能够同时在高电路深度下实现高保真度，并通过电路结构和码综合征的测量来认证实验保真度。由此产生的证书是设备相关的，但比现有保真度代理基准需要更弱的噪声假设。我们用一个64量子比特、深度为73的Clifford电路演示了本方案，其中掺杂了314个T门。我们总共使用76个物理量子比特将该计算编码到时空码中，在综合征后选择后有效抑制门错误率10倍，并产生一个保真度下限为0.349、置信度为95%的态。我们的构造是将稳定子态（stabilizer state）提升为魔法态（magic state）、同时保持错误检测保真度证书的一种系统性方法。

Abstract

Sampling-based proposals are prominent candidates for demonstrating quantum computations beyond the reach of classical supercomputers. However, it has been difficult to combine their complexity-theoretic hardness with two capabilities needed for scalable quantum computing more generally: suppressing hardware errors, and verifying the quantum computation itself. Here we address both issues by introducing structured circuits, which, in addition to provable hardness guarantees, admit an encoding in a quantum code. This allows us to simultaneously reach high fidelities at high circuit depths, and to certify an experimental fidelity via the circuit structure and measurement of code syndromes. The resulting certificate is device dependent, but requires substantially weaker noise assumptions than existing fidelity proxy benchmarks. We demonstrate our proposal with a $64$-qubit, depth-$73$ Clifford circuit, doped with $314$ $T$ gates. We use a total of $76$ physical qubits to encode this computation in spacetime codes, effectively suppressing gate error rates by $10\times$ after syndrome post-selection, and yielding a state with a fidelity lower bound of $0.349$ with $95\%$ confidence. Our construction is a systematic method for promoting a stabilizer state to a magic state while keeping an error-detected fidelity certificate.

摘要翻译

矩阵算术运算的高效实现是许多量子算法加速的基础。我们开发了一系列方法，利用输入算子的哈密顿演化来执行矩阵算术运算，并将结果编码在哈密顿量的非对角块中。我们展示了如何维持这种哈密顿块编码（Hamiltonian block encoding），使得矩阵运算可以连续复合，且整个量子计算只需不超过 2 个辅助量子比特（ancilla qubit）。我们对矩阵乘法、矩阵加法、矩阵求逆、厄米共轭、分数缩放、整数缩放、复相位缩放以及奇、偶多项式的奇异值变换均实现了这一点。我们还提出了一种重叠估计算法，用于提取哈密顿块编码算子的经典性质，类似于著名的 Hadamard 测试（Hadamard test），且无需额外的量子比特开销。我们的哈密顿矩阵乘法利用了李群交换子乘积公式（Lie group commutator product formula）及其 Childs 和 Wiebe 提出的高阶推广。我们的哈密顿奇异值变换采用了一种受控多项式近似（dominated polynomial approximation），即近似在感兴趣的区间内成立，而所构造的多项式在整个单位区间上以目标函数为上界。我们描述了一个用于模拟一类平方和哈密顿量的电路，在步数上实现了交换子缩放（commutator scaling），同时借助矩阵算术的能力降低了每一步模拟的成本。特别地，我们将此方法应用于近期量子化学研究中的双因子张量超收缩哈密顿量（doubly factorized tensor hypercontracted Hamiltonian），对固定粒子数的初始态获得了进一步改进。我们仅用 1 个辅助量子比特便实现了上述结果。

Abstract

The efficient implementation of matrix arithmetic operations underpins the speedups of many quantum algorithms. We develop a suite of methods to perform matrix arithmetics -- with the result encoded in the off-diagonal blocks of a Hamiltonian -- using Hamiltonian evolutions of input operators. We show how to maintain this $\textit{Hamiltonian block encoding}$, so that matrix operations can be composed one after another, and the entire quantum computation takes $\leq 2$ ancilla qubits. We achieve this for matrix multiplication, matrix addition, matrix inversion, Hermitian conjugation, fractional scaling, integer scaling, complex phase scaling, as well as singular value transformation for both odd and even polynomials. We also present an overlap estimation algorithm to extract classical properties of Hamiltonian block encoded operators, analogous to the well known Hadamard test, at no extra cost of qubit. Our Hamiltonian matrix multiplication uses the Lie group commutator product formula and its higher-order generalizations due to Childs and Wiebe. Our Hamiltonian singular value transformation employs a dominated polynomial approximation, where the approximation holds within the domain of interest, while the constructed polynomial is upper bounded by the target function over the entire unit interval. We describe a circuit for simulating a class of sum-of-squares Hamiltonians, attaining a commutator scaling in step count, while leveraging the power of matrix arithmetics to reduce the cost of each simulation step. In particular, we apply this to the doubly factorized tensor hypercontracted Hamiltonians from recent studies of quantum chemistry, obtaining further improvements for initial states with a fixed number of particles. We achieve this with $1$ ancilla qubit.

摘要翻译

量子计量学通常利用纠缠态来达到超越标准量子极限的测量精度。其优势随纠缠态规模的增大而增强，然而，制备并保持大规模纠缠态仍是一项重大的实验挑战。多通道协议提供了一种替代方案，允许单一探针与目标参数进行重复交互，但其性能极易受损耗影响——损耗在连续通道中累积，迅速削弱量子优势。在此，我们提出一种混合策略，将小规模、抗损耗的纠缠态与多通道干涉测量相结合。研究表明，该方法既保留了小型纠缠探针的稳健性，又通过重复交互实现了测量精度的显著提升。此外，我们基于现有技术提出了一种具体实施方案，证明所预测的性能增益应可通过当前实验能力加以实现。

Abstract

Quantum metrology typically uses entangled states to achieve measurement precisions beyond the standard quantum limit. The advantage increases with the size of the entangled state, however generating and preserving large entangled states remains a major experimental challenge. Multipass protocols offer an alternative approach by allowing a single probe to interact repeatedly with the parameter of interest, but their performance is highly susceptible to loss, which accumulates over successive passes and rapidly erodes the quantum advantage. Here we introduce a hybrid strategy that combines small, loss-resilient entangled states with multipass interferometry. We show that this approach retains the robustness of small entangled probes while exploiting repeated interactions to achieve substantial enhancements in measurement precision. Furthermore, we propose a concrete implementation using currently available technologies, demonstrating that the predicted performance gains should be experimentally accessible with existing capabilities.

摘要翻译

与连续对称性相容的量子纠错是量子信息中的一个基本问题，也是实现稳健的类比(analog)量子模拟的可能途径。由于Eastin-Knill定理禁止具有连续横向对称性的精确码，我们构造了显式的$SU(d)$-协变近似码，利用置换对称性将逻辑信息均匀散布到所有物理子系统上。对于位置已知的单qudit（d维量子比特）、双qudit和三qudit擦除，我们证明最坏情况纯化距离(purified distance)的标度为$O(1/N)$，该结果在常数意义下与已知的近似Eastin-Knill下界匹配；并将约化态分析推广到一般带标记的局域噪声。这类精确置换对称性仅对不超过三个擦除位置有效；对于任意固定数量$k$的擦除位置，我们转而证明，Haar随机且可高效采样的编码能够以指数接近1的概率实现最坏情况距离$O(\sqrt{k}/N)$。对于单qudit擦除，我们从Petz恢复映射构造了显式的近最优解码器。随后，我们将这些码用作编码类比动力学的构建模块。保对称哈密顿量生成具有分块结构、可横向实现的动力学李代数，而受控的对称性破缺项则作为通用动力学的非横向资源。这些结果提供了显式的非阿贝尔协变码，以及稳健类比量子模拟的框架。

Abstract

Quantum error correction compatible with continuous symmetries is a fundamental problem in quantum information and a possible route to robust analog quantum simulation. Because the Eastin-Knill theorem forbids exact codes with continuous transversal symmetries, we construct explicit $SU(d)$-covariant approximate codes that exploit permutation symmetry to spread logical information uniformly across all physical subsystems. For one-, two-, and three-qudit erasures at known locations, we prove worst-case purified-distance scaling $O(1/N)$, which matches known approximate Eastin-Knill lower bounds up to constants, and we extend the reduced-state analysis to general flagged local noise. Exact permutation symmetry of this kind is available only up to three erased sites; for an arbitrary fixed number $k$ of erased sites, we instead show that Haar-random and efficiently sampled encodings achieve worst-case distance $O(\sqrt{k}/N)$ with probability exponentially close to one. For single-qudit erasure, we construct an explicit near-optimal decoder from the Petz recovery map. We then use these codes as building blocks for encoded analog dynamics. Symmetry-preserving Hamiltonians generate block-structured dynamical Lie algebras implementable transversally, while controlled symmetry-breaking terms serve as non-transversal resources for universal dynamics. These results provide explicit non-Abelian covariant codes and a framework for robust analog quantum simulation.

理解噪声对当前和下一代量子器件所施加的限制，是展示实用量子优势的关键一步。在本工作中，我们研究熵密度（entropy density）的累积，作为一种监测量子处理单元（QPU）性能的基准。我们提供了方法的原理验证演示，包括建立熵累积的简单启发式模型，使用真实QPU数据进行测试，并最终利用这些模型确定一个电路体积阈值，超过该阈值即无法实现量子优势。监测熵密度不仅提供了一种补充现有电路级基准测试技术的替代方法，更重要的是，它弥合了电路级与应用级基准测试协议之间的差距。特别地，我们提出的熵累积启发式模型使我们能够超越现有的量子优势电路规模阈值界定技术。

Abstract

Understanding the limitations imposed by noise on current and next-generation quantum devices is a crucial step toward demonstrating practical quantum advantage. In this work, we investigate the accumulation of entropy density as a benchmark to monitor the performance of quantum processing units (QPUs). We provide a proof-of-principle demonstration of our methodology which entails developing simple heuristic models of how entropy accumulates, testing them against real QPU data, and finally using these models to determine a circuit volume threshold above which quantum advantage is unattainable. Monitoring entropy density not only offers an alternative approach that complements existing circuit-level benchmarking techniques, but, more importantly, it bridges the gap between circuit-level and application-level benchmarking protocols. In particular, our heuristic model of entropy accumulation allows us to outperform existing techniques that bound the circuit-size threshold for quantum advantage.

TL;DR: This paper studies the structure of quantum secret sharing codes with a special helper party, fully characterizes blind helper stabilizer codes, and shows that recovery of a single encoded qubit is always possible via one-way LOCC, extending to larger authorized subsets.
摘要翻译

Helper量子秘密共享是一种由其独特访问结构定义的特殊秘密共享形式。一个特定的固定参与方被称为助手（helper），它可以与任何其他参与方协作以完全解码秘密。盲助手（blind helper）是指在提供这种协助的同时，不持有关于编码秘密的任何本地信息的参与方。在本工作中，我们分析了QSS助手码的一般结构，并提出了新的码构造。我们完整刻画了盲助手稳定子码的结构，并证明对于单量子比特的编码，从助手到目标参与方的单向本地操作与经典通信（LOCC）总能实现恢复。此外，我们展示了这类码如何允许助手通过单向LOCC将目标扩展到更大的参与方子集，使其被授权恢复秘密。最后，当每个参与方仅持有一个量子比特时，我们确定了所有助手码（包括非稳定子码）的一般形式，并发现LOCC恢复仅在特殊情况下可行。

Abstract

Helper quantum secret sharing is a form of secret sharing defined by its unique access structure. One special fixed party, called the helper, can work together with any other party to fully decode the secret. A blind helper is one who can provide this assistance while not holding any local information about the encoded secret. In this work, we analyze the general structure of QSS helper codes and present new code constructions. We fully characterize the structure of blind helper stabilizer codes and show that for the encoding of a single qubit, recovery is always possible using one-way local operations and classical communication (LOCC) from the helper to the targeted party. Furthermore, we demonstrate how such codes also allow for the helper to target larger subsets of parties by one-way LOCC, enabling them to be authorized to recover the secret. Finally, when each party only holds a qubit, we identify the general form of all helper codes (including non-stabilizer codes) and find that LOCC recovery is only possible in special cases.

TL;DR: 该论文提出将量子力学理解为一种可逆扩散理论，通过时间对称的随机过程和非经典概率解释波函数，并试图仅基于概率论而非线性薛定谔方程推导叠加原理及经典极限。
摘要翻译

本文提出一种对量子力学的诠释，其基础是量子粒子的时间对称随机动力学以及非经典概率论。我们的主要目的是证明波函数及其复共轭可以被解释为两个复扩散方程中的复概率分布，这两个方程分别与向前和向后的非真实时间随机运动相关。我们称其为非真实的，因为薛定谔向前和向后扩散同时描述了可逆（真实轨迹）和不可逆轨迹（非真实轨迹）。可逆轨迹是仅有的真实轨迹，由那些向前和向后过程的交集给出。结果证明，如果我们用集合论语言来表述这一交集，就会得到一个由玻恩规则概率描述的可逆扩散。这一提议也有助于进一步解释量子力学中复数的作用，这种作用产生了所谓的量子实在的“波动样”本质。我们的视角还挑战了物理叠加的概念，并旨在推导叠加原理，不是基于薛定谔方程的线性，而是依赖于纯粹的概率论。此外，我们建议，接受量子理论中的随机过程思想，可以解释为什么大物体出现经典行为而小物体表现出量子行为。换言之，我们主张将波函数的概率性且非实在论（但也不是纯粹认识论）的观点与随机隐变量方法相结合，可能为量子物理实在提供一些洞见，并可能为量子力学的新诠释奠定基础。

Abstract

This paper proposes an interpretation of quantum mechanics, relying on the time-symmetric stochastic dynamics of quantum particles and on non-classical probability theory. Our main purpose is to demonstrate that the wave function and its complex conjugate can be interpreted as complex probability distributions in two complex diffusion equations related to non-real forward and backward in time stochastic motions respectively. We say non-real because Schroedinger forward and backward diffusions describe both reversible (real trajectories) and irreversible trajectories (non-real trajectories). The reversible trajectories are the only real trajectories and are given by the intersection of those forward and backward processes. It turns out that if we translate this intersection using set-theoretic language, we are led to a reversible diffusion described by Born rule probabilities. This proposal is useful also for explaining more about the role of complex numbers in quantum mechanics that produces this so-called "wave-like" nature of quantum reality. Our perspective also challenges the notion of physical superposition and aims at a derivation of superposition principle not based on the linearity of Schroedinger's equation but relying on pure probability theory. Moreover, it is suggested that, embracing the idea of stochastic processes in quantum theory, explains the reasons for the appearance of classical behavior in large objects, in contrast to the quantum behavior of small ones. In other words, we claim that a combination of a probabilistic and no-ontic view (neither epistemic though) of the wave function with a stochastic hidden-variables approach, may provide some insight into the quantum physical reality and potentially establish the groundwork for a novel interpretation of quantum mechanics.

摘要翻译

Jaynes-Cummings哈密顿量描述了一个二能级系统与光子模式相互作用的基本图像。本文回顾了电子二能级系统的Jaynes-Cummings形式体系，旨在总结并关联与实验中通常探测的透射响应相关的关键理论概念。本综述提供了响应光子模式描述，并给出了若干极限情况下的解析结果。这些表达式有助于深入理解和直观把握影响测量响应的因素。我们还将光子响应与该领域的几个关键概念联系起来：量子比特读出中的色散位移、半导体纳米结构的量子电容以及二能级系统的有效耗散率。

Abstract

Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonian provides the elemental description of a two-level system interacting with a photonic mode. In this work, we review the Jaynes-Cummings formalism for an electronic two-level system. The purpose is to summarize and connect together the key theory concepts relevant for the transmission response probed typically in the experiments. The review provides a photonic mode description of the response with analytical results for several limiting cases. These expressions are useful for gaining understanding and intuition on what influences the measured response. We also connect the photonic response to several key concepts in the field: the dispersive shift in qubit readout, the quantum capacitance of semiconductor nanostructures and the effective dissipation rate of the two-level system.

TL;DR: 该工作将渐近等分性质推广到两组量子态之间，证明相关量子散度收敛到正则化相对熵，并建立一个无需精确表征被操作态的量子资源理论框架，在此框架中正则化相对熵充当唯一资源度量。
摘要翻译

渐近等分性质（asymptotic equipartition property, AEP）表明，在大量独立同分布（independent and identically distributed, i.i.d.）随机实验的极限下，输出序列几乎必然来自典型集（typical set），且典型集中的每个元素几乎等可能出现。该性质是大数定律的一种形式，位于信息论的核心。在本工作中，我们在超越i.i.d.框架的意义上证明了一个广义量子AEP，其中随机样本取自两组量子态。特别地，在关于这两组集合的适当假设下，我们证明了所有操作相关的散度（divergence）都收敛到集合之间的量子相对熵（quantum relative entropy）。更具体地，量子假设检验相对熵（quantum hypothesis testing relative entropy）和平滑最大相对熵（smoothed max-relative entropy）都趋于集合之间的正则化相对熵（regularized relative entropy）。值得注意的是，尽管涉及正则化，只要这些集合具有有效的描述，渐近极限具有显式的收敛保证，并且可以通过凸优化程序高效估计。该广义AEP直接蕴含了一个新的量子Stein引理，用于在两组量子态之间进行量子假设检验。结合随附的工作[IEEE TIT 72(4):2330-2342 (2026)]，这解决了Brandao等人[IEEE TIT 66(8):5037-5054 (2020)]和Mosonyi等人[IEEE TIT 68(2):1032-1067 (2022)]提出的关于寻求具有计算效率的Stein引理的开放问题。此外，我们提出了一种新的量子资源理论框架，其中态变换无需对待操作态进行精确表征即可执行，从而对缺陷具有更强的鲁棒性。我们证明了该理论的可逆性（也称为第二定律），并确定正则化相对熵为该新框架中资源的唯一度量。

Abstract

The asymptotic equipartition property (AEP) states that in the limit of a large number of independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) random experiments, the output sequence is virtually certain to come from the typical set, each member of which is almost equally likely. This property is a form of the law of large numbers and lies at the heart of information theory. In this work, we prove a generalized quantum AEP beyond the i.i.d. framework where the random samples are drawn from two sets of quantum states. In particular, under suitable assumptions on the sets, we prove that all operationally relevant divergences converge to the quantum relative entropy between the sets. More specifically, both the quantum hypothesis testing relative entropy and the smoothed max-relative entropy approach the regularized relative entropy between the sets. Notably, the asymptotic limit has explicit convergence guarantees and can be efficiently estimated through convex optimization programs, despite the regularization, provided that the sets have efficient descriptions. The generalized AEP directly implies a new quantum Stein's lemma for conducting quantum hypothesis testing between two sets of quantum states. Combined with the accompanying work [IEEE TIT 72(4):2330-2342 (2026)], this addresses open questions raised by Brandao et al. [IEEE TIT 66(8):5037-5054 (2020)] and Mosonyi et al. [IEEE TIT 68(2):1032-1067 (2022)], which seek a Stein's lemma with computational efficiency. Moreover, we propose a new framework for quantum resource theory in which state transformations are performed without requiring precise characterization of the states being manipulated, making it more robust to imperfections. We demonstrate the reversibility (also referred to as the second law) of such a theory and identify the regularized relative entropy as the unique measure of the resource in this new framework.

TL;DR: The paper introduces energetic cost functions to optimize Wigner negativity in coherent pulse scattering by a two-level emitter in a 1D waveguide, identifying an energetic witness that correlates with achievable negativity and reveals a maximal energy-efficiency regime at spectral mode matching.
摘要翻译

Wigner负性是量子技术的关键资源，但在多模散射系统中难以优化。我们研究了由耦合到一维波导的二能级发射体对相干脉冲的散射，并引入了能量代价函数，使得无需重建完整Wigner函数即可优化Wigner负性。通过将散射能量分解为相干、热、压缩和非高斯贡献，我们识别出一种能量见证，该见证在所有驱动机制下与可实现的负性密切相关。该方法筛选出最优输出时间模式，并揭示了在亚光子输入能量下产生可观Wigner负性的工作点。我们进一步在光谱模式匹配条件下识别出最大能量效率区域，此时发射体有效实现了真空选择性π相移，从而产生巨大的光学非线性。这些结果确立了能量优化作为在波导量子电动力学及相关玻色子散射平台中工程化Wigner负性光子态的实用途径。

Abstract

Wigner negativity is a key resource for quantum technologies but is difficult to optimize in multimode scattering systems. We study the scattering of coherent pulses by a two-level emitter coupled to a one-dimensional waveguide and introduce energetic cost functions that enable the optimization of Wigner negativity without reconstructing the full Wigner function. By decomposing the scattered energy into coherent, thermal, squeezing, and non-Gaussian contributions, we identify an energetic witness that strongly correlates with the achievable negativity across all driving regimes. This approach singles out optimal output temporal modes and uncovers operating points generating appreciable Wigner negativity with sub-photon input energies. We further identify a maximal energy-efficiency regime at spectral mode matching, where the emitter effectively implements a vacuum-selective $π$ phase shift, realizing a giant optical nonlinearity. These results establish energetic optimization as a practical route to engineering Wigner-negative photonic states in waveguide quantum electrodynamics and related bosonic scattering platforms.

摘要翻译

我们研究粒子被限制在空间曲线附近时的有效动力学。在非简并横向基态的严格薄层约化中，挠率不进入局部有效哈密顿量，后者仅包含由曲率诱导的标量几何势。相比之下，对于具有有限横向宽度的薄波导，对二重简并的第一激发横向能带进行前导阶绝热投影，会使Frenet法向标架的旋转具有动力学相关性，并生成一个矩阵值的阿贝尔规范势。利用共转Frenet标架基中的投影推导，我们证明该有效规范势直接由曲线的局部挠率决定。所得有效哈密顿量具有规范协变形式，并产生两支横向模分支，其抛物线色散在动量空间中沿相反方向移动。对于闭合曲线，相应的和乐由积分挠率控制，并导致几何干涉。这些结果直接实现了弯曲量子波导中纯粹由空间几何诱导的Wilczek–Zee型联络。我们进一步利用各向同性弹性杆的简并弯曲模式构建了一个经典波类比，证明相同的挠率诱导规范结构出现在连续介质波物理中。

Abstract

We investigate the effective dynamics of a particle confined near a space curve. In the strict thin-layer reduction of the nondegenerate transverse ground state, torsion does not enter the local effective Hamiltonian, which contains only the curvature-induced scalar geometric potential. In contrast, for a thin guide with finite transverse width, a leading-order adiabatic projection onto the twofold-degenerate first-excited transverse band renders the rotation of the Frenet normal frame dynamically relevant and generates a matrix-valued Abelian gauge potential. Using a projection-based derivation in a co-rotating Frenet-frame basis, we show that this effective gauge potential is directly determined by the local torsion of the curve. The resulting effective Hamiltonian takes a gauge-covariant form and produces two transverse-mode branches whose parabolic dispersions are shifted in opposite directions in momentum space. For closed curves, the associated holonomy is controlled by the integrated torsion and leads to geometric interference. These results provide a direct realization of a Wilczek--Zee-type connection induced purely by spatial geometry in curved quantum waveguides. We further construct a classical-wave analogue using the degenerate bending modes of an isotropic elastic rod, demonstrating that the same torsion-induced gauge structure appears in continuum wave physics.

TL;DR: 我们提出了一种量子算法，在仅有黑盒访问未知量子通道时，通过量子奇异值变换对其奇异值进行多项式变换，并给出了查询复杂度界限，可应用于测试量子通道是否具有纠缠破坏性。
摘要翻译

在能够对作用于\(d\)维系统的未知量子通道进行应用的前提下，我们开发了一种用于变换其奇异值的量子算法。量子通道作为超算符的谱与其Liouville表示自然相关，而后者通常是非厄米的。我们的主要贡献是：在仅能对通道进行黑箱访问的情况下，构造了该表示的厄米化形式的近似块编码（block-encoding）方案；这使我们能够立即通过量子奇异值变换（QSVT）对通道的奇异值应用多项式变换。随后，我们证明了构造一个量子通道的查询复杂度具有\(O(d^3/\delta)\)的上界和\(\Omega(d/\delta)\)的下界，该量子通道在金刚石范数（diamond norm）下与未归一化的厄米化Liouville表示的块编码\(\delta\)-接近。我们展示了该方法实际应用于学习未知量子通道的第\(q\)阶奇异值矩（其中\(q>2\)，\(q\in\mathbb{R}\)）的问题，这对测试量子通道是否具有纠缠破坏性（entanglement breaking）具有重要意义。我们的结果为利用QSVT及相关方法操控黑箱量子通道建立了一个通用框架，使得无需进行量子层析（tomography）或大量经典后处理即可直接评估通道的谱性质。

Abstract

Given the ability to apply an unknown quantum channel acting on a $d$-dimensional system, we develop a quantum algorithm for transforming its singular values. The spectrum of a quantum channel as a superoperator is naturally tied to its Liouville representation, which is in general non-Hermitian. Our key contribution is an approximate block-encoding scheme for this representation in a Hermitized form, given only black-box access to the channel; this immediately allows us to apply polynomial transformations to the channel's singular values by quantum singular value transformation (QSVT). We then demonstrate an $O(d^3/δ)$ upper bound and an $Ω(d/δ)$ lower bound for the query complexity of constructing a quantum channel that is $δ$-close in diamond norm to a block-encoding of the unnormalized Hermitized Liouville representation. We show our method applies practically to the problem of learning the $q$-th singular value moments of unknown quantum channels for arbitrary $q>2, q\in \mathbb{R}$, which has implications for testing if a quantum channel is entanglement breaking. Our results establish a general framework for manipulating black-box quantum channels with QSVT and related methods, enabling direct evaluation of the channel's spectral properties without tomography or significant classical post-processing.

摘要翻译

拓扑光准粒子，如经典和量子光学斯格明子，迄今依赖于完全相干或纯量子态，其拓扑结构编码在偏振与二维空间模式之间的纠缠中。在此，我们表明斯格明子拓扑可以直接出现在混合量子态的密度矩阵中。我们引入了一个框架，其中相干-斯托克斯矢量定义了密度矩阵上的拓扑纹理，使得仅利用赝自旋和一个真实或合成的一维模式空间即可实现量子斯格明子。对于单光子，密度矩阵类似于经典光的相干矩阵，并且可以用部分相干电磁场进行编码。我们进一步分析了编码在双光子纠缠对中的拓扑纹理，展示了斯格明子如何不仅出现在完整的双光子系统中，而且同时出现在其任何赝自旋-模式组合的约化子空间中。然后，我们探讨了此类斯格明子对环境噪声的鲁棒性，并发现它们在多光子的混合量子态中依然存在。最后，我们提出了一条利用集成光子网络生成和测量此类斯格明子的可行实验路径，并为在其他量子系统中实现类似方案提出了途径。我们的工作为在部分相干光或混合量子态上稳健地编码经典信息，以及在多体量子系统上编码拓扑电荷铺平了道路。

Abstract

Topological quasiparticles of light, such as classical and quantum optical skyrmions, have so far relied on fully coherent or pure quantum states whose topology is encoded in the entanglement between polarization and two-dimensional spatial modes. Here we show that skyrmionic topology can emerge directly within the density matrix of a mixed quantum state. We introduce a framework in which a coherence-Stokes vector defines a topological texture over the density matrix, enabling the realization of quantum skyrmions using only a pseudospin and a real or synthetic one-dimensional space of modes. For a single photon, the density matrix is analogous to the coherence matrix of classical light, and can be encoded using partially coherent electromagnetic fields. We further analyze the topological texture encoded in a bipartite entangled photon pair, showing how skyrmions arise not only in the full bi-photon system, but also in its reduced subspaces with any pseudospin-mode combination simultaneously. We then explore the robustness of such skyrmions to environmental noise, and discover their persistence in mixed-quantum states of multiple photons. Finally, we propose a feasible experimental route to generate and measure such skyrmions using integrated photonic networks, and suggest avenues for similar implementations in other quantum systems. Our work paves the way for robustly encoding classical information on partially coherent light or on mixed quantum states and for encoding topological charges on many-body quantum systems.

TL;DR: The paper proposes classes of noncontextuality inequalities that certify bipartite entanglement without prior measurement characterization, and demonstrates through theory and photonic experiments that these inequalities can certify entangled states where Bell or steering inequalities fail.
摘要翻译

通过将贝尔定域性假设与广义非语境性假设相结合，我们为贝尔双体线路中产生的关联定义了几类非语境性不等式。这些类别依据完整操作恒等式集合中的哪些子集被用作非语境性原理的输入来区分；某些自然子集形成一个层级，为理解和分类量子关联（包括纠缠、导引和非定域性）提供了新途径。该层级的每一级对应一类非语境性不等式，其违反见证了上述双体量子资源性的一种形式，从而产生不同的纠缠充分条件。所得到的纠缠认证范式无需对测量进行先验表征，独立于层析规范自由度，并且可在没有辅助纠缠源的情况下认证任意纠缠态。为说明其威力，我们展示了非语境性不等式能够为两量子比特各向同性态家族认证纠缠，而贝尔不等式或导引不等式对这些态已知失效。我们还表明，与贝尔测试相比，该方法能认证更大比例的纠缠态，同时相关的成员归属问题更易处理。在实验方面，我们描述了在噪声及不完美实现条件下确保非平凡操作恒等式有效的方法。我们还确定了这些技术成立的关键假设，即一种特定的层析完备性概念，它保证了操作恒等式的规范无关性。最后，我们利用偏振纠缠光子对该纠缠认证技术的优越性能进行了实验演示。

Abstract

By combining the assumptions of Bell locality with those of generalized noncontextuality, we define classes of noncontextuality inequalities for correlations arising in a bipartite Bell circuit. These classes are distinguished by which subsets of the full set of operational identities are taken as input to the principle of noncontextuality; certain natural subsets form a hierarchy that provides a new way of understanding and classifying quantum correlations, including entanglement, steering, and nonlocality. Each level of this hierarchy gives rise to a corresponding class of noncontextuality inequalities whose violation witnesses one of these forms of bipartite quantum resourcefulness, thereby yielding different sufficient conditions for entanglement. The resulting entanglement certification paradigm requires no prior characterization of the measurements, is independent of tomographic gauge freedom, and can certify any entangled state without auxiliary entangled sources. To illustrate its power, we show that noncontextuality inequalities can certify entanglement for families of two-qubit isotropic states for which Bell or steering inequalities are known to fail. We also show that, compared with the Bell test, this approach certifies a much larger fraction of entangled states, while the associated membership problem is more tractable. On the experimental side, we describe techniques to ensure nontrivial operational identities in the presence of noisy and imperfect implementations. We also identify the key assumption under which these techniques are valid, namely, a particular notion of tomographic completeness, which ensures that the operational identities are gauge-independent. Finally, we provide an experimental demonstration of the superior performance of this entanglement certification technique using polarization-entangled photons.

产生非局域纠缠电子对对于固态量子信息处理至关重要。然而，由于电子隧穿（ET）和局域安德烈夫反射（AR）等竞争输运过程的存在，分离潜在的交叉安德烈夫反射（CAR）颇具挑战性。在此，我们提出一种磁通可调的四端正常金属-超导体结，可实现确定性、100%效率的CAR。我们证明，在恰好半个磁通量子（φ=π）处，精确的破坏性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆和皮尔斯干涉分别从结构上禁止了ET和AR。通过调节中心结跳跃，电子反射也被抑制为零。利用柯西辐角原理，我们证明这种抑制表现为量子化的拓扑绕数，保证了拓扑保护的单位CAR概率。我们确定该区域的特征是严格正的三阶相关散粒噪声，为库珀对分裂提供了明确的实验特征。此外，这种完美CAR在超导带隙内几乎具有宽带特性，并且对结构无序具有显著鲁棒性，为确定性非局域纠缠产生提供了一种高度弹性的架构。

Abstract

Generating non-locally entangled electron pairs via Cooper-pair splitting is vital for solid-state quantum information processing. However, isolating the underlying crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) is challenging due to competing transport processes like electron tunneling (ET) and local Andreev reflection (AR). Here, we propose a flux-tunable four-terminal normal metal-superconductor junction that achieves deterministic, 100\% efficient CAR. We demonstrate that at exactly half a magnetic flux quantum ($φ=π$), exact destructive Aharonov-Bohm and Peierls interferences structurally forbid ET and AR respectively. By tuning the central junction hopping, electron reflection is also suppressed to zero. Using the Cauchy argument principle, we prove that this suppression manifests as a quantized topological winding number, guaranteeing a topologically protected unit CAR probability. We establish that this regime is characterized by a strictly positive cross-correlation shot noise, providing an unambiguous experimental signature of Cooper-pair splitting. Furthermore, this perfect CAR is nearly broadband within the superconducting gap and remarkably robust against structural disorder, offering a highly resilient architecture for deterministic nonlocal entanglement generation.

TL;DR: 该论文通过正则化Aichelburg-Sexl冲击波几何研究ER=EPR猜想，计算了光子对的引力自能，发现其极小且与纠缠结构无关，暗示需要量子引力描述才能实现真正的ER=EPR连接。
摘要翻译

我们通过将点状源在弦论启发的长度标度 \(l_0\) 上涂抹，对无质量粒子的 Aichelburg-Sexl 冲击波几何进行正则化。横向几何的径向延拓容许一种零喉爱因斯坦-罗森诠释。对于纵向尺度为 \(L\) 的光子波包，一对横向分离光子的正则化引力自能为 \[ E_{\rm GSE}\sim \frac{4G(\hbar\omega)^2}{c^4L} \ln\!\left(\frac{d^2}{l_0^2}\right), \] 其中 \(d\) 为横向分离距离。因子 \(1/L\) 强烈抑制了这种相互作用，使得光学光子的引力稳定时标大于 \(10^{30}\) 年。我们还考察了冲击波几何的一种有效的二维纠缠熵描述。该熵构造重现了对 \(d\)、\(L\) 和 \(l_0\) 的相同依赖关系，并可通过校准重现直接自能计算的归一化结果。然而我们发现在能量-动量分布相同的 Bell 纠缠光子对与未纠缠光子对之间，由引力诱导的额外熵以及由此方案推得的自能是相同的。这与直接的几何计算一致，因为经典的双冲击波度规仅依赖于应力-能量张量，而不依赖于偏振纠缠。因此，当前的构造应被理解为受 ER=EPR 启发的半经典 ER 型几何，而非该猜想的完整实现。若一种几何的连通性要追踪量子纠缠量的大小，就需要一种对超出单点应力-能量张量的、依赖于态的关联敏感的全量子引力描述。

Abstract

We regularize the Aichelburg-Sexl shock-wave geometry for massless particles by smearing the point-like source over a string-inspired length scale $l_0$. A radial extension of the transverse geometry admits a zero-throat Einstein-Rosen interpretation. For a photon wave packet of longitudinal extent $L$, the regularized gravitational self-energy of a transversely separated pair is $E_{\rm GSE}\sim \frac{4G(\hbarω)^2}{c^4L} \ln\!\left(\frac{d^2}{l_0^2}\right)$, where $d$ is the transverse separation. The factor $1/L$ strongly suppresses the interaction, giving gravitational stability times greater than $10^{30}$ years for optical photons. We also examine an effective two-dimensional entanglement-entropy description of the shock-wave geometry. The entropy construction reproduces the same dependence on the scales $d$, $L$, and $l_0$, and can be calibrated to reproduce the normalization of the direct self-energy calculation. However, we find that the gravitationally induced excess entropy, and hence the self-energy inferred from this prescription, is the same for Bell-entangled and unentangled photon pairs having identical energy-momentum distributions. This agrees with the direct geometrical calculation, since the classical two-shock metric depends on the stress-energy tensor but not on the polarization entanglement. The present construction should therefore be understood as a semiclassical ER-like geometry motivated by ER=EPR, rather than as a complete realization of the conjecture. A geometry whose connectivity tracks the amount of quantum entanglement would require a quantum-gravitational description sensitive to state-dependent correlations beyond the one-point stress-energy tensor.

TL;DR: 该论文推导了在波导QED中整形频率可调单光子所需控制的方法，使得频率失谐的量子网络节点间能够进行确定性量子态传输和远程纠缠生成，并通过数值模拟验证了方案的高保真度。
摘要翻译

在量子网络（quantum network）中实现节点间的量子信息交换是现代技术的主要挑战之一。超导波导QED网络（superconducting waveguide QED networks）为实现分布式量子计算（distributed quantum computation）提供了巨大潜力，其中不同节点借助行波单光子（itinerant single photons）进行通信。然而，节点间的频率差异限制了其适用范围和可扩展性。本文推导了所需控制方法，用于整形与其固有频率任意失谐的单光子，从而允许在频率失谐节点间进行按需且确定性的量子信息交换。我们提供了理论框架，分析了典型光子形状下控制方法的特性，并划定了适合实验实现的操作区域。随后，我们展示了这些控制如何实现现实网络中非共振且远距离节点间的频率选择性量子态传输，并提供了一种简单的扩展方法以在这些节点间产生远程纠缠。数值模拟验证了这些协议的适用性和高保真度，凸显了通过整形频率可调单光子所开辟的全新组网可能性。

Abstract

The exchange of quantum information among nodes in a quantum network is one of the main challenges in modern technologies. Superconducting waveguide QED networks hold great potential for realizing distributed quantum computation, where distinct nodes communicate via itinerant single photons. Yet, different frequencies among the nodes restrict their applicability and limit scalability. Here we derive the controls required to shape single photons arbitrarily detuned with respect to their natural frequency, allowing thus for an on-demand and deterministic exchange of quantum information among frequency detuned nodes. We provide a theoretical framework, analyzing the properties of the controls for typical photon shapes, identifying operation regimes amenable for experimental realization. We then show how these controls enable frequency-selective quantum state transfer among non-resonant and distant nodes of a realistic network. In addition, we also provide a simple extension for remote entanglement generation between these nodes. The suitability and high-fidelity of these protocols is supported by numerical simulations, highlighting the novel networking possibilities unlocked when shaping frequency-tunable single photons.

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何通过机器学习方法逐级估计噪声并自适应地选择串联的量子纠错码，从而以显著更少的物理量子比特达到目标逻辑错误率。
摘要翻译

串接量子纠错码通过跨层级将逻辑错误率以双指数形式降低，从而增强纠错能力。然而，串接会导致噪声结构发生变化，使得选择最优的码序列变得困难。我们通过在每个层级后估计有效噪声信道并据此选择下一个码，来实现这一选择的自动化。特别是，当噪声展现出足够结构时，我们采用基于学习的方法来定制小型非可加编码器，而在噪声接近均匀后则切换至标准码。在仿真中，这种逐层自适应方法以远少于仅串接稳定子码所需的量子比特数达到目标逻辑错误率——对于强结构噪声，量子比特数可减少多达两个数量级。因此，这种基于学习的混合策略为早期容错量子计算提供了一种有前景的工具。

Abstract

Concatenating quantum error correction codes scales error correction capability by driving logical error rates down double-exponentially across levels. However, the noise structure shifts under concatenation, making it hard to choose an optimal code sequence. We automate this choice by estimating the effective noise channel after each level and selecting the next code accordingly. In particular, we use learning-based methods to tailor small, non-additive encoders when the noise exhibits sufficient structure, then switch to standard codes once the noise is nearly uniform. In simulations, this level-wise adaptation achieves a target logical error rate with far fewer qubits than concatenating stabilizer codes alone--reducing qubit counts by up to two orders of magnitude for strongly structured noise. Therefore, this hybrid, learning-based strategy offers a promising tool for early fault-tolerant quantum computing.

摘要翻译

我们提出一种协议，仅使用单个辅助量子比特即可同时估计量子谐振子位移信道的两个正交分量，且无需复杂的态制备或自适应控制。所述量子比特通过强度为$A$的受控位移与量子谐振子耦合，并经历$N$轮测量与重置，而谐振子则相干地积累位移信号。非对易位移在每一轮中留下依赖于作用次序的几何相位，从而产生随$\mathcal{O}(A^{2} N^{3})$标度的量子费希尔信息。尽管测量记录空间按$2^N$增长，我们证明任意单个测量记录的精确似然均可在$\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$时间内计算。在此基础上，我们表明在计算基下的测量近似饱和量子界限，并保持$\mathcal{O}(A^2 N^3)$的标度。此外，周期性信息提取使该协议对退相干具有鲁棒性。我们的结果为辅助比特辅助协议中顺序测量的设计与分析提供了一个框架。

Abstract

We present a protocol for simultaneous estimation of both quadratures of a displacement channel on a quantum harmonic oscillator using a single ancilla qubit, without complex state preparation or adaptive control. The qubit is coupled to the quantum harmonic oscillator via controlled displacements of strength $A$ and undergoes $N$ rounds of measurement and reset, while the oscillator coherently accumulates the displacement signal. The non-commuting displacements imprint an order-dependent geometric phase at each round, giving a quantum Fisher information that scales as $\mathcal{O}(A^{2} N^{3})$. Although the measurement record space grows as $2^N$, we show that exact likelihoods for any individual measurement record can be computed in $\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$ time. With this, we show that measurement in the computational basis approximately saturates the quantum bound and maintains the $\mathcal{O}(A^2 N^3)$ scaling. Furthermore, the periodic information extraction makes the protocol robust to decoherence. Our results provide a framework for the design and analysis of sequential measurement in ancilla-assisted protocols.

TL;DR: 该论文探讨了可交换测量上下文的经典概率律能否全局或协议级地整合为单一经典表示，证明了全局整合与Bell-CHSH非局域性中的兼容性条件密切相关，而协议级整合总是可以通过直和构造实现。
摘要翻译

假设给出一族交换测量情境（commutative measurement contexts）以及相应的经典概率律。我们研究的问题是：在什么条件下，这些按情境给出的描述可以被合并为单一的经典表示。我们区分两种可完成该合并的方式。在全局整合（global integration）中，所规定的可观测量代数要求被嵌入到单一交换情境中，相应的概率律则要求成为某个联合律的边缘分布。相比之下，在逐协议整合（protocolwise integration）中，情境标签保留作为描述的一部分，各情境律在测量协议的一个单一模型中表现为条件分布。我们证明，全局整合涉及两种不同的相容性概念：底层可观测量的算子代数相容性（operator-algebraic compatibility），以及它们经典化后的律的概率相容性（probabilistic compatibility）。前者蕴含后者，但反过来不成立；在如下所陈述的拓扑假设下，概率相容性可由一个Kellerer型边缘准则来刻画。另一方面，逐协议整合总是存在，并在算子代数意义上由直和构造（direct-sum construction）表示。当全局整合存在时，这两种构造均作为某个公共交换加细（common commutative refinement）的约简而出现。我们以Bell–CHSH实验来说明这一区别：Fine定理将全局概率整合与Bell局域性和CHSH不等式联系起来。这表明，Bell–CHSH所揭示的障碍并不在于经典表示本身，而在于保持特定的跨情境同一化（cross-context identifications）的经典表示。

Abstract

Suppose that a family of commutative measurement contexts is given, together with the corresponding classical probability laws. We study the problem under what conditions these contextwise descriptions can be combined into a single classical representation. We distinguish two ways in which this can be done. In {\em global integration}, the prescribed observable algebras are required to fit into a single commutative context and the corresponding probability laws to arise as marginals of one joint law. In {\em protocolwise integration}, by contrast, the context label is retained as part of the description, and the contextwise laws appear as conditional distributions within a single model of the measurement protocol. We show that global integration involves two distinct notions of compatibility: operator-algebraic compatibility of the underlying observables and probabilistic compatibility of their classicalised laws. The former implies the latter, but the converse fails; under the topological hypotheses stated below, probabilistic compatibility is characterised by a Kellerer-type marginal criterion. Protocolwise integration, on the other hand, always exists and is represented operator-algebraically by a direct-sum construction. When global integration exists, the two constructions arise as reductions of a common commutative refinement. We illustrate the distinction in the Bell--CHSH experiment, where Fine's theorem relates global probabilistic integration to Bell locality and the CHSH inequalities. This shows that the obstruction revealed by Bell--CHSH concerns not classical representation as such, but classical representation preserving specified cross-context identifications.

TL;DR: 论文揭示了多拷贝量子学习任务的无限层级：对于每个素数c，存在需要用c份拷贝测量才能高效求解、而用c-1份拷贝则指数困难的学习任务，该结论还可推广到所有无平方因子整数，展示了样本复杂度的相变现象。
摘要翻译

从测量数据中学习量子态的性质是量子信息领域的一项基本挑战。此类任务的样本复杂度（sample complexity）关键取决于测量基元（measurement primitive）。虽然影子层析（shadow tomography）通过允许跨多个副本的纠缠测量而实现样本高效的学习，但所需的电路深度过大，难以实际实现。在另一个极端，双副本测量（two-copy measurements）在泡利层析（Pauli tomography）等任务中已经展现出相对于单副本策略的指数级优势。在这项工作中，我们表明这种鲜明的分离远不止于双副本情形：对于每个素数 c，我们构造了度数为 c（degree c）的显式学习任务——这类任务在使用 (c-1)-副本测量时是指数级困难的，但在使用 c-副本测量时却可以高效求解。我们的协议不仅样本高效，还可通过浅层电路（shallow circuits）实现。进一步地，我们证明这类有限度数任务（finite-degree tasks）对所有无平方因子整数（square-free integers）c 都存在，指向一个有关其存在的普遍原理。总体而言，我们的结果揭示了一个多副本学习问题的无限层级结构，发现了样本复杂度中新的相变，并强调了可靠量子存储（quantum memory）作为实现指数级量子优势的关键资源的作用。

Abstract

Learning properties of quantum states from measurement data is a fundamental challenge in quantum information. The sample complexity of such tasks depends crucially on the measurement primitive. While shadow tomography achieves sample-efficient learning by allowing entangling measurements across many copies, it requires prohibitively deep circuits. At the other extreme, two-copy measurements already yield exponential advantages over single-copy strategies in tasks such as Pauli tomography. In this work we show that such sharp separations extend far beyond the two-copy regime: for every prime c we construct explicit learning tasks of degree c, which are exponentially hard with (c - 1)-copy measurements but efficiently solvable with c-copy measurements. Our protocols are not only sample-efficient but also realizable with shallow circuits. Extending further, we show that such finite-degree tasks exist for all square-free integers c, pointing toward a general principle underlying their existence. Together, our results reveal an infinite hierarchy of multi-copy learning problems, uncovering new phase transitions in sample complexity and underscoring the role of reliable quantum memory as a key resource for exponential quantum advantage.

摘要翻译

随着量子传感器、模拟器和网络的出现，量子技术的未来可能将量子态作为数据来产生——即相干地而非以经典测量记录的方式——从而激发对现代机器学习适当量子推广的研究，包括自动化、无监督地提取有用表示。后者包含两个核心要素：推断，即将观测映射到潜在表示；以及生成，即将潜在状态映射回合成数据。两者彼此相关，并通过经典概率论的链式法则与用于训练模型的联合分布相关。然而，量子态缺乏这种普遍、标准的因式分解性质，因此构成了挑战。在此，我们为从量子数据中进行无监督表示学习建立一个概念性和数学性框架。模型是可见系统与潜在系统上的联合量子态；状态随时间演化的映射提供了因式分解为边缘状态与推断（生成）通道的概念；具有推断（生成）的模型是模糊态——即获得这种因式分解的状态——并需满足关于数据扩展的扩展推断映射的进一步一致性条件。这些规定具有限制性：我们证明非平凡模型必须包含到扩展空间的非线性映射。对于三种具有代表性的状态随时间演化映射，我们完整刻画了模糊态，揭示了与纠缠理论中的正部分转置（PPT）准则相关的层级结构。值得注意的是，Leifer-Spekkens构造恰好为PPT态类别的模型提供了推断和生成支持，从而允许真正的量子可见-潜在相关性。我们还制定了精确和近似推断训练的量子对应物，探索了较弱的数据扩展概念，并勾勒了未来的研究计划。

Abstract

With quantum sensors, simulators and networks emerging, a future of quantum technology may produce quantum states as data---that is, coherently rather than as classical measurement records---thus motivating the study of suitable quantum generalisations of modern machine learning, including the automated, unsupervised extraction of useful representations. Two ingredients are central to the latter: inference, mapping observations to latent representations, and generation, mapping latent states back to synthetic data. Both are related to each other and to joint distributions for training models by the chain-rule of classical probability theory. The fact that quantum states however lack such universal, standard factorisation property thus poses a challenge. Here we develop a conceptual and mathematical framework for unsupervised representation learning from quantum data. Models are joint quantum states over visible and latent systems; state-over-time maps provide a notion of factorisation into a marginal state and inference (generation) channel; models with inference (generation) are ambiguous states---states for which such factorisation obtains---subject to a further consistency condition on extended inference maps as data extension. These stipulations are restrictive: we show that non-trivial models must feature non-linear such maps to the extended space. For three representative state-over-time maps, we completely characterise the ambiguous states, uncovering a hierarchy tied to the positive-partial-transpose (PPT) criterion from entanglement theory. Notably, the Leifer-Spekkens construction supports inference and generation exactly for model classes of PPT states, thus allowing genuinely quantum visible-latent correlations. We also formulate quantum counterparts of exact and approximate inference training, explore weaker notions of data extension and sketch a future research programme.

81. Quantum Secret Sharing with a Helper and Programmable Access Structures PASS

Published: 2026-08-31

TL;DR: The paper proposes a 'helper QSS' variant of quantum secret sharing where a designated helper with any group of shareholders can reconstruct the state, and introduces programmable access structures implemented blindly via quantum steering, for arbitrary numbers of parties and system sizes.
摘要翻译

量子秘密共享（Quantum secret sharing, QSS）是一个将量子系统状态分割为多份共享份额的过程，仅允许特定的股东子集重建该状态，而其他方则无法获知其身份信息。在本研究中，我们提出了一种量子秘密共享的变体，称为“辅助量子秘密共享”（helper QSS），该方案指定了一个特殊股东，其与任何其他参与方群体的合作便足以恢复该状态。我们提出了多族适用于任意参与方数量和系统规模的辅助码。作为应用之一，我们引入了量子秘密共享中可编程访问结构（programmable access structure）的概念，该结构允许第三方编程者在份额已分发至所有股东之后，仍能独立选择码的访问结构。此选择是盲选的，即编程者对正在编码的秘密信息一无所知，并通过量子导引（quantum steering）的非局域过程来实现。

Abstract

Quantum secret sharing (QSS) is a process in which the state of a quantum system is partitioned into multiple shares, allowing only specific subsets of shareholders to reconstruct the state, while others gain no information about its identity. In this work, we propose a variant of QSS, called ``helper QSS,'' which designates a special shareholder whose participation with any other group of parties is sufficient for recovering the state. We present different families of helper codes that function for an arbitrary number of parties and system sizes. As an application, we introduce the idea of a programmable access structure in QSS, which allows for a third-party programmer to independently choose the access structure of the code even after the shares are delivered to all the shareholders. This choice is made blindly, meaning that the programmer has no information about the secret being encoded, and it is implemented using the nonlocal process of quantum steering.

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个框架描述非绝热量子演化中子空间的准和乐，证明动力学与几何效应的分离本质上依赖于历史，无法构成真正的规范联络。
摘要翻译

我们发展了一个框架，用于描述复Grassmann流形中沿闭合路径的子空间非绝热量子时间演化的准和乐（quasi-holonomy）。通过在移动基中将薛定谔演化分解为动力学贡献与联络诱导贡献，我们得到了一个有效几何生成元，它显式依赖于动力学传播子。该准联络在原Grassmann丛上并不定义真正的联络，因为其规范变换律含有一个依赖于历史、非局域的项。我们简要讨论了薛定谔演化的其他分解方式。所有这些方法都遭受同一类型的历史依赖性，从而定义了子空间的输运，其中几何与动力学效应通常相互纠缠，正如准和乐的情形一样。我们的工作从本质上规范场论的角度，阐明了将子空间的量子演化分离为和乐部分与动力学部分这一问题。

Abstract

We develop a framework for quasi-holonomy in non-adiabatic quantum time evolution of subspaces along loops in a complex Grassmannian. By factoring the Schrödinger evolution into dynamical and connection-induced contributions in a moving basis, we obtain an effective geometric generator that depends explicitly on the dynamical propagator. This quasi-connection does not define a genuine connection on the original Grassmann bundle, since its gauge transformation law acquires a history-dependent, nonlocal term. Other ways of factoring the Schrödinger evolution are briefly discussed. All these approaches suffer from the same type of history-dependence, thereby defining transport of subspaces in which geometric and dynamical effects are generally intertwined, just as in the case of the quasi-holonomy. Our work sheds light on the issue of separating quantum evolution of subspaces into holonomic and dynamical parts from an essentially gauge-theoretic perspective.

83. Toward Uncertainty-Aware and Generalizable Neural Decoding for Quantum LDPC Codes PASS

TL;DR: 该论文提出了不确定性感知且可泛化的量子LDPC码神经解码器QuBA及其多阶段训练框架SAGU，在多种量子码上显著降低了逻辑错误率，优于经典置信传播解码器。
摘要翻译

量子纠错(QEC)对可扩展量子计算至关重要。然而，通过常规算法进行解码时，其逻辑错误抑制精度有限且开销较高，而这两方面均可借助基于推理的解码器得到缓解。迄今为止，此类机器学习(ML)解码器仍缺乏对实际容错至关重要的两个关键性质：可靠的不确定性量化，以及对先前未见QEC码的鲁棒泛化能力。为填补这一空白，我们提出了量子贝叶斯图注意力解码器(QuBA)，它能够在进行高表达力错误模式识别的同时，给出经过校准的不确定性估计。在QuBA的基础上，我们进一步开发了一种多阶段训练框架——不确定性下的序列聚合泛化(Sequential Aggregate Generalization under Uncertainty, SAGU)，该框架具有增强的跨域鲁棒性，使解码能够推广到训练集之外的码。在双变量自行车(bivariate bicycle, BB)码及其互素变体上的实验表明：(i) QuBA与SAGU均在互素BB码$[[154,6,16]]$上持续优于经典基线置信传播(BP)，并在置信决策界下实现了逻辑错误率(LER)高达两个数量级的降低；(ii) SAGU获得了与QuBA特定域训练方法相当、甚至更优的解码性能。

Abstract

Quantum error correction (QEC) is essential for scalable quantum computing, yet decoding errors via conventional algorithms result in limited accuracy (i.e., suppression of logical errors) and high overheads, both of which can be alleviated by inference-based decoders. To date, such machine-learning (ML) decoders lack two key properties crucial for practical fault tolerance: reliable uncertainty quantification and robust generalization to previously unseen QEC codes. To address this gap, we propose a Quantum Bayesian graph Attention decoder \textbf{(QuBA)} that enables expressive error-pattern recognition alongside calibrated uncertainty estimates. Building on QuBA, we further develop a multi-phase training framework with enhanced cross-domain robustness enabling decoding beyond the training set called Sequential Aggregate Generalization under Uncertainty \textbf{(SAGU)}. Experiments on bivariate bicycle (BB) codes and their coprime variants demonstrate that (i) both QuBA and SAGU consistently outperform the classical baseline belief propagation (BP), achieving up to a \emph{two orders of magnitude} reduction in logical error rate (LER) under confident-decision bounds on the coprime BB code $[[154,6,16]]$; (ii) SAGU achieves decoding performance comparable to or even outperforming QuBA's domain-specific training approach.

Our results establish the use of non-Gaussian quantum-states in battery charging as a robust route to a quantum precision advantage over protocols based on Gaussian states, achieved through the suppression of detrimental quantum fluctuations.

摘要翻译

我们利用从SU(3)群表示论获得的完备的双qutrit（三态量子比特）纠缠态集合，演示了qutrit系统的量子隐形传态。我们系统评估了端到端隐形传态所需的所有测量门，并发现它们是非幺正的。我们的方法以最小改动将Bennett隐形传态协议扩展到qutrit系统，保持了操作的简洁性，并强调了高维系统中非幺正测量算符的必要性。

Abstract

We demonstrate quantum teleportation of a qutrit system using a complete set of two-qutrit entangled states obtained from the representation theory of the SU(3) group. All measurement gates essential for end-to-end teleportation are systematically evaluated, and these are found to be non-unitary. Our approach extends Bennett's teleportation protocol to the qutrit system with minimal modifications, preserving operational simplicity and underscoring the necessity of non-unitary measurement operators in high-dimensional systems.

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种带认证的商校准方法（CQC），利用加权投影轨道和有限样本界来判定周期控制下简化的校准扫描是否有效，并给出实验验证和样本节省。
摘要翻译

周期性控制可以使量子校准扫描变得冗余，但编译、噪声和测量可能破坏该约简背后的对称性。我们提出认证商校准（Certified Quotient Calibration, CQC），用于审计电路振幅是否具有公共正分次，并定义加权射影空间（weighted-projective-space, WPS）控制轨道。基于先导计数，它通过U_in和L_out界定所提议的轨道内最大平方Hellinger距离与经审计的轨道间最小平方Hellinger距离。CQC仅当这些界限满足任务容差、保留经审计的备选方案，并在计入认证成本后仍实现净节省时才接受；否则它拒绝或推迟约简。 该定理在一个置信事件上界定了被接受的轨道替换和取值于[0,1]的校准目标。其成本推论仅在包含认证成本的总成本低于完整网格扫描成本时，才授权仅对代表点进行扫描。加权射影下降、Hellinger检验速率和多项分布集中性是标准工具；本文的贡献在于将它们组合为一种有限发数下的“接受–拒绝–推迟”保证，用于任务误差和净校准成本。 在IQM Garnet以及IBM Marrakesh、Kingston和Fez上的门级实验，覆盖了编译后的一量子位、二量子位和三量子位族中的所有三种决策。在IBM Kingston上预先注册的二量子位Bell相位实验中，先导审计发现U_in=0.01922<L_out=0.09030，商扫描和完整扫描在两种注入相位偏移下均选择了相同的校正轨道。新鲜保留计数满足预设的0.03非劣效性界限。计入18,432次先导发射，商程序共使用36,864次而非55,296次总发射，减少了33.3%。这些结果支持CQC在所述族中的决策路径，但并不能推广到固有三次脉冲规律、设备无关的WPS轨道或普适的节省率。

Abstract

Periodic controls can make a quantum-calibration scan redundant, but compilation, noise, and measurement can invalidate the symmetry behind that reduction. We introduce Certified Quotient Calibration (CQC), which audits whether circuit amplitudes have a common positive grading and define weighted-projective-space (WPS) control orbits. From pilot counts it bounds the largest proposed within-orbit and smallest audited between-orbit squared Hellinger distances by U_in and L_out. CQC accepts only when these bounds meet a task tolerance, preserve audited alternatives, and imply a net saving after certification cost; otherwise it rejects or defers the reduction. The theorem bounds accepted orbit substitutions and [0,1]-valued calibration objectives on one confidence event. Its cost corollary authorizes a representative-only scan only when its certification-inclusive cost is below that of the full grid. Weighted-projective descent, Hellinger testing rates, and multinomial concentration are standard; the contribution is their combination into a finite-shot approve--reject--defer guarantee for task error and net calibration cost. Gate-level experiments on IQM Garnet and IBM Marrakesh, Kingston, and Fez exercise all three decisions in compiled one-, two-, and three-qubit families. In a preregistered two-qubit Bell-phase experiment on IBM Kingston, the pilot audit found U_in=0.01922<L_out=0.09030, and quotient and full scans selected the same correction orbit for both injected phase offsets. Fresh held-out counts met the prespecified 0.03 noninferiority margin. Including 18,432 pilot shots, the quotient procedure used 36,864 rather than 55,296 total shots, a 33.3% reduction. These results support the CQC decision path for the tested families, but not a native cubic pulse law, a device-independent WPS orbit, or a universal saving rate.

摘要翻译

量子计量学为各种传感任务提供了量子增强精度的可能性。在本手稿中，我们解决了单次量子参数学习理论中的两个开放问题，超越了通过重复测量进行局部参数估计的常规设定。第一个问题涉及学习精度全局上界的构建。第二个问题涉及参数学习成功概率的严格保证，即给定量子计量任务所用资源的约束条件下，以一定精度学习参数的概率下界。我们为量子参数学习提供了严格、实用且全局的上界以及成功概率保证。最重要的是，我们建立了一个基于保真度的学习保证，适用于一般混合态模型，可视为量子克拉美-罗界的可实现性对应物。后者基于保真度的局部曲率提供了一种不可行性约束，而我们的界仅使用参数编码态之间的两两保真度，即可证明以预定的精度和保证的成功概率是可达的。我们通过一个涉及受驱动量子比特耦合到玻色子环境的拉比频率学习示例以及一个集体自旋哈密顿量学习问题，展示了新界的多功能性。总之，新的全局界和成功概率保证使我们能够排除不可达的精度，并验证超出标准费希尔信息分析或二元假设检验界所能证实的可达精度。它们还允许我们在无需显式模拟的开销下，简便地刻画各种学习方案的性能。

Abstract

Quantum metrology offers the possibility of quantum enhancements of the precision of various sensing tasks. In this manuscript, we tackle two open problems in the theory of single-shot quantum parameter learning, going beyond the usual setting of local parameter estimation via repeated measurements. The first concerns the construction of global upper bounds on the learning precision. The second concerns rigorous guarantees on the success probability of parameter learning, namely, lower bounds on the probability of learning a parameter with a certain precision, given the constraints on the resources used for the quantum metrology task. We provide rigorous, practical, and global upper bounds and success-probability guarantees for quantum parameter learning. Most importantly, we establish a fidelity-based learning guarantee for generic mixed-state models that can be viewed as the achievability-side analogue of the quantum Cramer-Rao bound. Whereas the latter provides a no-go constraint, based on the local curvature of the fidelities, our bound uses only pairwise fidelities between parameter-encoded states to certify that a prescribed precision is attainable with a guaranteed success probability. We demonstrate the versatility of the new bounds in a Rabi-frequency-learning example involving a driven qubit coupled to a bosonic environment and a collective-spin Hamiltonian learning problem. Together, the new global bounds and success-probability guarantees allow us to rule out unattainable precision and to certify attainable precision beyond what is possible via standard Fisher-information analysis or binary hypothesis testing bounds. They also allow one to tractably characterize the performance of various learning schemes, without the overhead of an explicit simulation.

TL;DR: 本文提出将薛定谔-长谷川变换的正反扩散场提升为分支超过程，证明其均值精确复现薛定谔动力学，并揭示了扩展的Born密度与有限关联范围在新随机核中的共存机制。
摘要翻译

有限程关联能否隐藏在扩展量子态的统计之中？薛定谔-长泽变换（Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform）用一对正的前向与后向扩散场表示波函数，其乘积即为玻恩密度（Born density）。我们将这些场提升为分支超过程（branching superprocesses）\(Φ_F\) 和 \(Φ_B\)：扩散过程抽取随机路径，而玻姆/费希尔（Bohm/Fisher）控制的分支过程生成替代延续的谱系。当速率按预设的玻恩密度评估时，它们的均值能精确再现薛定谔动力学。连通扇区（connected sector）在受限条件下表现出超临界、临界与亚临界聚集，并在自由空间中具有临界维度 \(d_c=2\)。定态本征模仍是扩展的；亚临界团簇则获得约化的德布罗意尺度。随后，我们让分支速率对涨落乘积 \(Φ_FΦ_B\) 作出响应。在对偶基（reciprocal basis）中，两个场分别等于一个光滑参考 \(R\) 加上中心化涨落 \(ψ_F,ψ_B\)，从而定义了有符号核（signed kernel） \(C_{\rm FB}(x,y)=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_F(x)ψ_B(y)]\)。在反关联分支（anticorrelated branch）上，\(ρ_{\rm BSM}(x)=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)\) 是正的配对密度。定态恢复要求其对角元匹配玻恩分布轮廓，而非对角元的衰减则定义关联范围。配对方程分解为集体扇区与相对扇区：谱抵消选择玻恩集体模，而对主导密度涨落的抑制则选择反关联源通道。在相对扩散系数 \(D_{\rm eff}\) 和正弛豫率 \(μ_{\rm FB}\) 下，关联具有屏蔽长度 \(ξ_{\rm FB}=\sqrt{D_{\rm eff}/μ_{\rm FB}}\)。因此，一个扩展的玻恩密度与有限的关联范围可以共存于同一个随机核（stochastic kernel）之中，这暗示着类粒子式的组织方式。

Abstract

Can finite-range correlations hide in the statistics of an extended quantum state? The Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform represents the wave function by positive forward and backward diffusion fields whose product is the Born density. We promote them to branching superprocesses, \(Φ_F\) and \(Φ_B\): diffusion samples stochastic paths, whereas Bohm/Fisher-controlled branching generates genealogies of alternative continuations. With rates evaluated on the prescribed Born density, their means reproduce Schrödinger dynamics exactly. The connected sector exhibits supercritical, critical, and subcritical clustering in confinement and has critical dimension \(d_c=2\) in free space. Stationary eigenmodes remain extended; subcritical clusters acquire the reduced de~Broglie scale. We then let the branching rate respond to the fluctuating product \(Φ_FΦ_B\). In the reciprocal basis, the fields equal a smooth reference \(R\) plus centered fluctuations \(ψ_F,ψ_B\), defining the signed kernel \(C_{\rm FB}(x,y)=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_F(x)ψ_B(y)]\). On the anticorrelated branch, \(ρ_{\rm BSM}(x)=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)\) is the positive paired density. Stationary recovery requires its diagonal to match the Born profile, while off-diagonal decay defines the correlation range. The pair equation splits into collective and relative sectors: spectral cancellation selects the Born collective mode, while suppression of the leading density fluctuation selects the anticorrelated source channel. With relative diffusivity \(D_{\rm eff}\) and positive relaxation rate \(μ_{\rm FB}\), correlations have screening length \(ξ_{\rm FB}=\sqrt{D_{\rm eff}/μ_{\rm FB}}\). Thus an extended Born density and a finite correlation range can coexist in one stochastic kernel, suggesting particle-like organization.

90. A Quantum Encoding of Traveling Salesperson Tours via Route Generation, Cost Phases, and a Reversible Valid-Permutation Oracle FAIL
Score: 2.0 / 3.0
Authors: Alexander Johannes Stasik, Franz Georg Fuchs
Published: 2026-03-22
Version: v4
TL;DR: 该论文为旅行商问题提出了一种紧凑的量子编码，通过时间寄存器表示路线，利用可逆有效性置换预言机和成本相位预言机将可行路线及其总成本编码为叠加态，并分析了所需的量子比特和门复杂度。
摘要翻译

针对包含 \(n\) 个城市的旅行商问题（TSP），我们提出了一种基于行程时间寄存器表示的紧凑量子编码。候选路线表示为离散时间步上的 \(n-1\) 个城市标签序列，其中一个固定起始城市，其余城市以二进制寄存器编码。我们描述了该构造的三个组成部分：路线寄存器上的均匀路线生成、可逆有效性预言机以及编码总行程成本的相位预言机。有效性预言机既检查非起始城市标签是否构成排列，又针对不完整图检查路线所使用的每条有向边是否存在。成本预言机随后将起始边、中间转移边和返回边的成本累加为有效路线的行程相关相位。由此生成候选路线的相干叠加，并将可行性和行程长度信息直接嵌入量子态中。完整构造使用 \(\mathcal{O}(n\log n)\) 个量子比特，而朴素实现需要 \(\mathcal{O}(n^3\log_2 n)\) 个 CX 门和 \(\mathcal{O}\!\left(n^3[\log_2 n+\log_2(1/\varepsilon)]\right)\) 个 \(T\) 门，其中 \(\varepsilon\) 表示目标近似精度。该编码兼容振幅放大或谱滤波技术，如量子奇异值变换（QSVT）或格罗弗算法。然而，由于有效路线所占比例呈指数级减小，即使结合振幅放大，整体复杂度仍为指数级。

Abstract

For a traveling salesperson problem (TSP) of $n$ cities, we present a compact quantum encoding based on a time-register representation of tours. A candidate route is represented as a sequence of $n-1$ city labels over discrete time steps, with one fixed start city and the remaining cities encoded in binary registers. We describe three ingredients of the construction: uniform route generation over the route register, a reversible validity oracle, and a phase oracle that encodes the total tour cost. The validity oracle checks both that the non-start city labels form a permutation and, for incomplete graphs, that every directed edge used by the route exists. The cost oracle then accumulates the start-edge, intermediate-transition, and return-edge costs into a tour-dependent phase for valid routes. This yields a coherent superposition of candidate routes with feasibility and tour-length information embedded directly in the quantum state. The complete construction uses $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ qubits, while a naive implementation requires $\mathcal{O}(n^3\log_2 n)$ CX gates and $\mathcal{O}\!\left(n^3[\log_2 n+\log_2(1/ε)]\right)$ $T$ gates, where $ε$ denotes the target approximation precision. The encoding is compatible with amplitude amplification or spectral filtering techniques such as the quantum singular value transform (QSVT) or Grover's algorithm. However, due to the exponentially small fraction of valid tours, the overall complexity remains exponential even when combined with amplitude amplification.

摘要翻译

测量量子系统可以在揭示信息的同时扰动其状态。因此，在单次测量中获得期望结果的概率会约束在顺序测量中获得这些结果的概率。这种相互作用在互不信任的量子密码学中自然出现：不诚实方可执行顺序测量以提取超出协议允许的更多信息。我们提出了连续测量定理（consecutive measurement theorems, CMTs）来量化这一约束，将单次测量的平均成功概率与一对不同测量按顺序执行时的平均成功概率联系起来。对于相同态上的测量，我们推导出连续测量成功概率作为单次测量成功概率函数的最优下界，并在整个参数范围内提供了匹配构造。我们还针对不同但相近态上的测量建立了首批鲁棒CMTs，其中态间的相近性由保真度（fidelity）或迹距离（trace distance）量化。借助这些结果，我们加强了相对论比特承诺的求和约束保证和相对论零知识证明的可靠性界，并得到了面向量子不经意传输与量子私有查询的改进型不可行性结果。这些成果确立了CMTs作为一种多用途工具，可将连续测量约束转化为具体的密码学边界，并表明其在其他量子信息场景中具有潜在应用价值。

Abstract

Measuring a quantum system can reveal information while disturbing its state. Consequently, the probabilities of obtaining desired outcomes in individual measurements constrain the probability of obtaining them in sequence. This interplay arises naturally in mistrustful quantum cryptography, where a dishonest participant may perform sequential measurements to extract more information than the protocol allows. We develop consecutive measurement theorems (CMTs) to quantify this constraint, relating the average success probability of a single measurement to that of an ordered pair of distinct measurements. For measurements on a common state, we derive the optimal lower bound on consecutive-measurement success as a function of single-measurement success and provide matching constructions over the entire parameter range. We also establish the first robust CMTs for measurements on different but nearby states, with closeness quantified by fidelity or trace distance. We use these results to strengthen sum-binding guarantees for relativistic bit commitment and soundness bounds for relativistic zero-knowledge proofs, and to obtain improved no-go results for quantum oblivious transfer and quantum private query. Our results establish CMTs as a versatile tool for translating consecutive-measurement constraints into concrete cryptographic bounds and suggest applications in other quantum-information settings.

TL;DR: 该论文研究了通过局域测量估计一维链耦合参数时，在存在次近邻相互作用等扰动下的误差标度行为，发现误差随扰动强度线性增长，并分析了可估计的链长范围。
摘要翻译

量子动力学中耦合的间接估计依赖于对能谱以及本征矢量与某些参考态重叠的测量。这些数据可通过在某些位点上的局域测量获得，从而免除了完整的哈密顿量层析成像。对于一维链，仅需接触一个边界位点即可计算所有相邻位点间的耦合，进而重构完整的哈密顿量。然而，在存在扰动的情况下，该方法的鲁棒性仍然是一个关键问题，尤其是当位点与最近邻之外的晶格位点发生相互作用时。 我们的工作研究了为一维链设计的方案在具有超越最近邻相互作用的拓扑结构中的适用性。我们将次近邻位点间的相互作用视为强度为$\varepsilon$的微扰，并证明在此类相互作用存在时，耦合估计误差随$\varepsilon$线性增长。此外，我们表明，平均而言，次近邻之外位点间耦合的存在会导致更大的误差。我们还研究了在存在次近邻相互作用的情况下，可估计（达到固定精度）的链长作为$\varepsilon$的函数。通常，对于弱相互作用，40个位点的链可在合理误差范围内被估计。因此，我们研究了为一维链设计的估计方案在暴露于此类多位点扰动时的鲁棒性，为其适用性和局限性提供了有价值的见解。

Abstract

The indirect estimation of couplings in quantum dynamics relies on the measurement of the spectrum and the overlap of eigenvectors with some reference states. This data can be obtained by local measurements on some sites and eliminates the need for full Hamiltonian tomography. For a 1D chain, access to only one edge site is sufficient to compute all the couplings between the adjacent sites, and consequently to reconstruct the full Hamiltonian. However, its robustness in the presence of perturbations remains a critical question, particularly when sites interact with other lattice sites beyond nearest neighbors. Our work studies the applicability of schemes designed for 1D chains to topologies with interactions beyond nearest-neighbour. We treat interactions between the next-nearest sites as perturbation of strength $\varepsilon$ and show that the error in estimation of couplings scales linearly with $\varepsilon$ in the presence of such interactions. Further, we show that on average, the existence of couplings between sites beyond the next-nearest neighbour results in higher error. We also study the length of the chain that can be estimated (up to a fixed precision) as a function of $\varepsilon$, in the presence of next-nearest neighbour interactions. Typically, for weak interactions, chains of 40 sites can be estimated within reasonable error. Thus, we study the robustness of estimation scheme designed for a 1D chain when exposed to such multi-site perturbations, offering valuable insights into its applicability and limitations.
