Abstract

We formulate position--momentum complementarity in a continuous categorical setting based on Schwartz rigged Hilbert spaces. The position and momentum descriptions are represented by distributional observable structures related by the Fourier transform associated with Pontryagin duality of the additive group $\mathbb{R}$. A positive normalization parameter $α$ is introduced independently of the physical constant $\hbar$, so that the character pairing takes the form $χ_{p}^{(α)}(x)=\exp(ipx/α)$. We show that the abstract Pontryagin duality fixes the form of the position -- momentum pairing but does not determine its dimensional normalization: the simultaneous rescaling $(p,α)\mapsto(cp,cα)$ leaves the character pairing unchanged. The momentum observable structure is obtained from the position structure by Fourier conjugation. In the continuous setting, we use the Weyl relations as an operational characterization of position -- momentum complementarity rather than asserting an unproved equivalence with the finite-dimensional Hopf-algebraic definition of strong complementarity. Imposing the physical canonical commutation relation $[\hat X,\hat P]=i\hbar I$ selects $α=\hbar$. The character then becomes $\exp(ipx/\hbar)=\exp(ikx)$, and its spatial period yields the de Broglie relation $λ=h/p$. The resulting analysis separates the structural content supplied by Fourier--Pontryagin duality from the physical normalization supplied by quantum mechanics.

摘要翻译

模拟量热器簇射是高能物理中最大的计算开销之一，量子生成模型已被提出作为经典代理模型的替代方案。它们的进展受到资源问题的阻碍。在现有的门模型（gate-model）方案中，量子寄存器随图像尺寸增大。基准数据集包含数千个单元，因此难以企及。我们提出量子特征放大网络（Quantum Feature Amplification Network, QFAN），它打破了寄存器大小与图像大小之间的关联。QFAN 将图像分割为连续的像素块，并逐块生成；每个块由同一个小的电路产生，该电路以已生成像素的固定长度摘要为条件。量子比特数量由块大小决定，而非图像维度。该电路用作采样器。每个块从一组有限的玻恩测量记录（Born measurement records）中解码，因此生成簇射的随机性源于测量随机性而非经典噪声。记录中可调比例的部分在块内像素间共享，以控制其相关性。在无噪声模拟器上使用解析梯度进行快速训练，所得模型随后部署于 IBM 的 Heron 量子处理单元（QPU）。仅使用三个量子比特和12（18）个共享量子电路参数，QFAN 即可在12像素和25像素基准上再现像素强度谱、像素间相关性和总沉积能量。我们通过消融研究（ablation study）量化量子组件的贡献，该研究移除单个流水线元件并重新拟合其余部分。将采样记录替换为它们的条件均值，仅去除了测量随机性，会使模型退化为单一确定性图像。在重新拟合每个经典阶段的同时令电路保持未训练，则无论在哪种图像尺寸下，既无法再现像素谱，也无法再现相关性。

Abstract

Simulating calorimeter showers is among the largest computational costs in high-energy physics, and quantum generative models have been proposed as alternatives to classical surrogates. Their progress is hindered by a resource problem. In existing gate-model proposals, the quantum register grows with the image size. Benchmark data sets have thousands of cells and are therefore out of reach. We introduce the Quantum Feature Amplification Network (QFAN), which breaks the link between register size and image size. QFAN splits an image into consecutive blocks of pixels and generates them one block at a time, each produced by the same small circuit conditioned on a fixed-length summary of the pixels already generated. The number of qubits is set by the block size, not by the image dimension. The circuit is used as a sampler. Each block is decoded from a finite set of Born measurement records, so the stochasticity of the generated shower arises from measurement randomness rather than classical noise. A tunable fraction of the records is shared among the pixels within a block to control their correlations. Fast training is performed on a noiseless simulator using analytic gradients, and the resulting model is then deployed on IBM's Heron QPU. Using only three qubits and 12 (18) shared quantum-circuit parameters, QFAN reproduces pixel-intensity spectra, inter-pixel correlations, and total deposited energy for 12- and 25-pixel benchmarks. We quantify the contribution of the quantum component through an ablation study in which individual pipeline elements are removed and the remainder refitted. Replacing the sampled records by their conditional means, which removes only the measurement randomness, collapses the model to a single deterministic image. Leaving the circuit untrained while refitting every classical stage reproduces neither the pixel spectra nor the correlations at either image size.

Abstract

Selecting anomalous samples and explanatory features under fixed cardinalities defines a coupled optimization problem: feature-first selection can overlook features whose usefulness depends on the selected samples. In the analyzed model, joint calibration-error sensitivity is sample-count independent, while the sum-column feature-first rule's sensitivity grows linearly. To optimize this formulation, we introduce Coupling-Grouped XY Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (CG-XY-QAOA), with constraint-preserving mixers and block-structured phase angles. 148. Quantum Private Distributed Matrix Multiplication: Extending the Classical Codes and Limitations FAIL
Score: 0.0 / 3.0
Authors: Mohamed Nomeir, Alptug Aytekin, Lei Hu, Sennur Ulukus
Published: 2025-11-28
Version: v2
TL;DR: The paper investigates how quantum resources can improve the rate of private distributed matrix multiplication by extending classical GASP, CAT, and DOG codes to the quantum setting, and analyzes feasibility conditions to achieve super-dense coding gains.
摘要翻译

本文探讨如何利用量子资源来提高私有分布式矩阵乘法（PDMM）的速率。在PDMM中，用户拥有两个高维矩阵 A 和 B，但缺乏在本地执行矩阵乘法的计算能力，因此将矩阵 A 和 B 分别划分为 K 个和 L 个子块。随后，用户将这些子块发送给 N 个服务器，以在私有条件下执行所需的乘法，即任意 T 个合谋服务器都无法获取用户矩阵的任何信息。其目标是减少执行所需矩阵乘法所需的服务器数量，从而降低通信开销。 首先，在高隐私情形（high-privacy regime）下，现有最先进的经典码称为间隙加性安全多项式（GASP）码。我们在量子场景中为 GASP 码定义一个可行性要求，使得当该要求被满足时，可实现最高性能。因此，当可行性条件满足时，即可获得超密编码（super-dense coding）增益。我们证明：当 T ≥ KL−K+1 时，可行性条件始终满足，且 GASP 码可推广至量子版本；在 T < KL−K+1 的情形下，可行性条件仍可能满足。为进一步研究这一行为，我们通过数值方法考察最小隐私需求如何依赖矩阵维度，并给出该关系的二次估计。结果表明，当 T ≈ 0.5KL 时，可行性可以实现。 其次，在低隐私情形（low-privacy regime）下，新近提出的循环加法次数表（CAT）码和离散优化GASP（DOG）码是现有最有效的 PDMM 经典构造之一。我们证明，为 GASP 开发的可行性条件同样适用于 CAT 码和 DOG 码，从而统一了多种经典 PDMM 编码方案的可行性框架。

Abstract

In this paper, we explore how quantum resources can be used to increase the rate of private distributed matrix multiplication (PDMM). In PDMM, a user who has two high-dimensional matrices, A and B, and lacks the computational capabilities to apply matrix multiplication locally, divides the matrices A and B into K and L sub-blocks, respectively. Then, the user sends them to N servers to apply the required multiplication \emph{privately}, i.e., any $T$ colluding servers cannot get any information about the user's matrices. The goal is to reduce the number of servers needed to perform the required matrix multiplication, thereby decreasing the communication cost. First, in the high-privacy regime, the state-of-the-art classical code is called the gap additive secure polynomial (GASP) code. We define a feasibility requirement in the quantum setting for the GASP code such that the highest performance is achieved when the requirement is satisfied. Thus, super-dense coding gain is achieved when the feasibility condition is satisfied. We show that when $T \geq KL-K+1$, the feasibility condition is always satisfied and the GASP code can be extended to the quantum version. In the case of $T < KL-K+1$, the feasibility can still be satisfied. To further examine this behavior, we numerically study how the minimum privacy requirement depends on the matrix dimensions and provide a quadratic estimate for this relation. The results suggest that feasibility can be achieved when $T \sim 0.5 KL$. Second, in the low-privacy regime, the recently developed cyclic-addition degree tables (CAT) and discretely optimized GASP (DOG) codes are among the most efficient known classical constructions for PDMM. We show that the feasibility condition developed for GASP can be adopted for both CAT and DOG codes as well, thus unifying the feasibility framework for multiple classical PDMM coding schemes.

149. The quantum algorithm for graph isomorphism problem FAIL
Score: 0.0 / 3.0
Authors: Xi Li, Hanwu Chen
Published: 2019-01-19
Version: v2
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种在多项式时间内判定图同构问题的量子算法，通过构建同构等价图并利用邻接矩阵特征向量的置换关系来求解。
摘要翻译

图同构（Graph Isomorphism, GI）问题是计算问题，即寻找给定图 \(G_1\) 的顶点置换，使该置换将 \(G_1\) 变换为另一给定图 \(G_2\) 并保持邻接关系。本文提出一种量子算法，用于判定是否存在这样的置换。为寻找该置换，我们引入了待测给定图的同构等价图，并证明了等价图的图同构问题与原图同构问题等价。算法思路是判定是否存在一个置换可使得等价图的邻接矩阵的特征向量相互转换。该算法的时间复杂度为多项式级。

Abstract

The graph isomorphism (GI) problem is the computational problem of finding a permutation of vertices of a given graph $G_1$ that transforms $G_1$ to another given graph $G_2$ and preserves the adjacency. In this work, we propose a quantum algorithm to determine whether there exists such a permutation. To find such a permutation, we introduce isomorphic equivalent graphs of the given graphs to be tested. We proof that the GI problem of the equivalent graphs is equivalent to the GI problem of the given graphs. The idea of the algorithm is to determine whether there exists a permutation can transform the eigenvectors of the adjacency matrix of the equivalent graphs each other. The cost time of the algorithm is polynomial.

150. The entropic coherence is a necessary resource for non-energy preserving gates FAIL
Score: 0.0 / 3.0
Authors: Riccardo Castellano, Vasco Cavina, Marti Perarnau-Llobet, Vittorio Giovannetti, Pavel Sekatski
Published: 2025-09-01
Version: v2
TL;DR: This paper proves that entropic coherence in an energy-conserving battery is a necessary resource for implementing non-energy preserving gates with prescribed precision, and establishes lower bounds on coherence, energy, and quantum Fisher information that can outperform previous universal limits.
摘要翻译

我们考虑通过外部电池B的保能量相互作用，在有限维系统S上实现非保能量门（NEPG）的任务。我们证明了电池的熵相干性（资源相对熵的一个实例）是此任务的必要资源，并给出了其所需最小量的下界——即为了以固定期望精度实现NEPG，电池中必须存在的最小熵相干量的下界。一个直接推论是，任何有限维电池在门实现任务中都注定存在一定的最小误差。此外，在关于电池哈密顿量能级密度的假设下，我们的主要结果还意味着实现任意门所需的最小能量和量子Fisher信息量存在额外的下界。我们表明，这些下界可以强于文献中先前建立的普适下界。

Abstract

We consider the task of implementing non-energy preserving gates (NEPG) on a finite-dimensional system S via an energy-preserving interaction with an external battery B. We prove that the entropic coherence of the battery (an instance of the relative entropy of resource) is a necessary resource for this task, and find a lower bound on its minimum amount that has to be present in the battery to be able to implement NEPGs with a fixed desired precision. An immediate corollary is that any finite-dimensional battery is doomed to a certain minimal error in the gate implementation task. Moreover, under assumptions on the density of energy levels in the battery Hamiltonian, our main results imply additional lower bounds on the minimal amount of energy and quantum Fisher information required to implement any gate. We show that these bounds can be stronger than the universal bounds previously established in the literature.
